a: Ze hammakkir mekom chavero bayyeshiva. ikka deamri, amar rabbi elazar: ze hamekabbel pene chavero bayyeshiva.
May "limchasse atik" — ze hamechasse devarim shekkissa attik yomin, umay ninhu? sitre tora. veikka deamri: ze hamegalle devarim shekkissa attik yomin, may ninhu? taame tora.
Amar rav kahana mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, may dichtiv: "lamnatztzeach mizmor ledavid" — zammeru lemi shennotzchin oto vesameach.

Bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. basar vadam — menatztzechin oto veatzev, aval hakkadosh baruch hu — notzchin oto vesameach, shenneemar: "vayyomer lehashemidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav".

Amar rav kahana mishshum rabbi yishmael berabbi yose amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: may dichtiv: "vide adam mittachat kanfehem", "yado" ketiv — ze yado shel hakkadosh baruch hu shepperusa tachat kanfe hachayyot kede lekabbel baale teshuva miyyad middat haddin.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol kesef vezahav shebbaolam yosef likketo vehevio lemitzrayim, shenneemar: "vaylakket yosef et kol hakkesef hannimtza". en li ella shebbeeretz mitzrayim veshebbeeretz kenaan, bishar aratzot minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechol haaretz bau mitzrayma".
Ucheshealu yisrael mimmitzrayim heeluhu immahen, shenneemar: "vaynatztzelu et mitzrayim", rav assi amar: asauha kimtzuda zo sheen bah dagan, rabbi shimon amar: kimtzula sheen bah dagim.

Vehaya munnach ad rechavam. ba shishak melech mitzrayim unetalo merchavam, shenneemar: "vayhi bashshana hachamishit lammelech rechavam ala shishak melech mitzrayim [al yerushalaym] vayyikkach et otzrot bet Adonai veet otzrot bet hammelech". ba zerach melech kush unetalo mishshishak.
Ba asa unetalo mizzerach melech kush veshiggero lehaderimmon ben tavrimmon. bau bene ammon unetalum mehaderimmon ben tavrimmon. ba yehoshafat unetalo mibbene ammon vehaya munnach ad achaz.

Ba sancheriv unetalo meachaz. ba chizkiyya unetalo missancheriv vehaya munnach ad tzidkiyya. bau kasdiyyim unetaluhu mitztzidkiyya. bau parsiyyim unetaluhu mikkasdiyyim. bau yevavnim unetaluhu mipparsiyyim. bau romiyyim unetaluhu miyyad yevavnim, vaadayin munnach beromi.
Amar rabbi chama (bar) chanina: shalosh matmoniyyot hitmin yosef bemitzrayim, achat nitgalla lekorach, veachat nitgalla leantoninus ben asvirus, veachat genuza letzaddikim leatid lavo.

"Osher shamur livalav leraato", amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: zo oshro shel korach. (shenneemar:) "veet kol hayekum asher beraglehem", amar rabbi elazar: ze mamono shel adam shemmaamido al raglav. amar rabbi levi: massooy shelosh meot peradot levanot hayu maftechot bet genazav shel korach, vechullehu aklide ukelippe degilda.

(315 315 344 71 Siman). amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: "odcha ki anitani" — amar david. "even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna" — amar yishay. "meet Adonai hayta zot" — amru echav. "ze hayyom asa Adonai" — amar shemuel.

"Anna Adonai hoshia na" — amru echav. "anna Adonai hatzelicha na" — amar david. "baruch habba beshem Adonai" — amar yishay. "berachnuchem mibbet Adonai" — amar shemuel. "el Adonai vayyaer lanu" — amru kullan. "isru chag baavotim" — amar shemuel. "eli atta veodekka" — amar david. "elohay arommekka" — amru kullan.
Tenan hatam: makom shennahagu
b: Lichpol — yichpol, lifshot — yifshot, levarech acharav — yevarech, hakkol keminhag hammedina. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella leacharav, aval lefanav — [mitzva] levarech. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammitzvot mevarech alehen over laasiyyaytan.

May mashma dehay "over" lishshana deakdome hu? amar rabbi nachman bar yitzchak, dichtiv: "vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi". abbaye amar, mehacha: "vehu avar lifnehem". ikka deamri mehacha: "vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham".
Tanya: rabbi kofel bah devarim, rabbi elazar ben parta mosif bah devarim. may mosif? amar abbaye: mosif lichpol meodcha" lematta.

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar leh mishshemeh derav amme vezimnin amar leh mishshemeh derav assi: may dichtiv: "vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal" — atid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot seuda latztzaddikim beyom sheyyigmol chasdo lezaro shel yitzchak. leachar sheochlin veshotin notnin lo leavraham avinu kos shel beracha levarech,

Veomer lahen: eni mevarech, sheyyatza mimmenni yishmael. omer lo leyitzchak: tol uvarech. omer lahen: eni mevarech, sheyyatza mimmenni esav. omer lo leyaakov: tol uvarech. omer lahem: eni mevarech, shennasati shete achayot bechayyehen, sheatida tora leosran alay.

Omer lo lemoshe: tol uvarech. omer lahem: eni mevarech, shello zachiti likkanes leeretz yisrael, lo bechayyay velo bemoti. omer lo lihoshua: tol uvarech, omer lahen: eni mevarech, shello zachiti leven, dichtiv: "yehoshua bin nun", "non beno yehoshua beno".
Omer lo ledavid: tol uvarech. omer lahen: ani avarech, veli nae levarech, shenneemar: "kos yeshuot essa uveshem Adonai ekra".
Mishna en maftirin achar happesach afikoman.
Gemara may afikoman? amar rav: shello yeakru mechavura lachavura.

Ushemuel amar: kegon ordilae li vegozalayyay leabba. verav chanina bar shela verabbi yochanan (amar) [amru]: kegon temarim kelayot veegozim. tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: en maftirin achar happesach kegon temarim kelayot veegozim.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en maftirin achar matztza afikoman. tenan: en maftirin achar happesach afikoman. achar happesach hu dela, aval leachar matztza — maftirin!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya achar matztza — dela nefish tamayyhu, aval leachar happesach, dinfish tameh vela matze abboreh — let lan ba, kamashma lan.
Nema mesayyay leh: hassufeganin vehadduveshanin vehaiskeritin, adam memalle kereso mehen, uvilvad sheyyochal kezayit matztza baacharona. baacharona in,

a: Barishona la. la mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya barishona — dekaachel leteavon, aval baacharona dilma ate lemechal achila gassa — ema la, ka mashma lan.

Mar zutera matne hachi: amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maftirin achar hammatztza afikoman. nema mesayyay leh, en maftirin achar happesach afikoman: achar happesach dela, aval achar matztza — maftirin.
La mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya achar matztza — dela nefish tameh, aval leachar pesach — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Metivi: hassufeganin vehadduveshanin vehaiskeritin adam memalle kereso mehen uvilvad sheyyochal (achilat) kezayit matztza baacharona. baacharona in, barishona la!
La mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya barishona — dekaachel leteavon, aval baacharona deate lemechla achila gassa — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Amar rava: matztza bizman hazze deorayyta, umaror derabbanan. umay shena maror, dichtiv: "al matztzot umerorim", bizman deikka pesach — yesh maror, uvizman delekka pesach — lekka maror.
Matztza name, ha ketiv: "al matztzot umerorim"! matztza mihdar hadar beh kera: "baerev tochlu matztzot". verav acha bar yaakov amar: echad ze veechad ze derabbanan.
Ella hachtiv: "baerev tochlu matztzot"! hahi mibbee leh letame veshehaya bederech rechoka, desalka datach amena kevan defesach la achli — matztza umaror name la nechol, ka mashma lan.
Verava amar lach: tame veshehaya bederech rechoka la tzerich kara, dela gari mearel uven nechar. detanya: "kol arel lo yochal bo" — "bo" eno ochel, aval ochel bematztza umaror.
Veiddach? ketiv behay uchetiv behay, utzerichi.
Tanya kevoteh derava: "sheshet yamim tochal matztzot uvayyom hashshevii atzeret laAdonai elohecha". ma shevii reshut, af sheshet yamim reshut.
May tama? have davar shehaya bakkelal, veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza.
Yachol af layla harishon reshut, talmud lomar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu".
En li ella bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym minnayin? talmud lomar: "baerev tochlu matztzot", hakkatuv kevao chova.
Mishna yashnu miktzatan — yochelu. kullan — lo yochelu.
b: Rabbi yose omer: nitnamnemu — yochelu, nirdemu — lo yochelu. happesach achar chatzot metamme et hayyadayim. happiggul vehannotar metammein et hayyadayim.

Gemara rabbi yose omer: nitnamnemu — yochelu, nirdemu — lo yochelu. hechi dame nitnamnem? amar rav ashe: nim vela nim, tir vela tir. kegon dekare leh veane, vela yada leahdore sevara, vechi madkeru leh — middechar.
Abbaye hava yatev kammeh derabba. chaza deka namnem, amar leh: menam ka naem mar. amar leh: menome ka (menamnem) [menamnamna], utenan: nitnamnemu — yochelu, nirdemu — lo yochelu.
Happesach achar chatzot metamme et hayyadayim vechulei. alma mechatzot have leh notar. man tanna?

Amar rav yosef: rabbi elazar ben azarya hu, detanya: "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze", rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: neemar kan "ballayla hazze", veneemar lehallan "veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayla hazze".
Ma lehallan — ad chatzot, af kan — ad chatzot.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: vahalo neemar "chippazon" — ad sheat chippazon.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "ballayla"? yachol yehe neechol kakkodashim bayyom — talmud lomar: "ballayla", ballayla hu neechol, veeno neechol beyom.

Verabbi akiva, hay "hazze" may aved leh? mibbee leh lemaote layla acher hu daata. salka datach amena: hoil ufesach kadashim kallim, ushelamim kadashim kallim — ma shelamim neechalim lishne yamim velayla echad, af pesach;
Okem lelot bimkom yamim, vihe neechol lishne lelot veyom echad, ketav rachamana: "hazze".
Verabbi elazar ben azarya amar lach: millo totiru ad boker" nafka ha.
Verabbi akiva amar lach: i la ketav rachamana "hazze", hava amena: may "boker" — boker sheni. verabbi elazar amar lach: kol hecha dichtav "boker" — boker rishon hu.
Amar rava: achal matztza bizman hazze achar chatzot, lerabbi elazar ben azarya lo yatza yede chovato. peshita! dechevan deittakkash lefesach — kefesach dame.
Mahu detema: ha appekeh kera mehekkesha. kamashma lan dechi ahdereh kera — lemilleta kammayyta ahdereh.
Happiggul vehannotar metamme et hayyadayim vechulei. rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: mishshum chashede chehunna, vechad amar: mishshum atzele chehunna. chad amar: kezayit, vechad amar: kevetza.

a: Chad tane appiggul, vechad tane annotar.
Man detane appiggul — mishshum chashede chehunna. man detane annotar — mishshum atzele chehunna.
Chad amar kezayit vechad amar kevetza. man deamar kezayit — keissuro, uman deamar kevetza — ketumeato.
Mishna berach birkat happesach — patar et shel zevach. berach et shel zevach — lo patar et shel pesach, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lo zo poteret zo velo zo poteret zo.
Gemara keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi yishmael: zerika bichlal sheficha. velo sheficha bichlal zerika.
Ledivre rabbi akiva: lo sheficha bichlal zerika, velo zerika bichlal sheficha.
b: Rabbi simlay ikkela lefidyon habben, beo minneh: peshita al pidyon habben "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al pidyon habben" — avi habben mevarech. "baruch ... shehecheyaynu vekiyyeymanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze", kohen mevarech, o avi habben mevarech?

Kohen mevarach — dekamate hanaa lideh, o avi habben mevarech — deka aved mitzva? la hava bideh, ata sheel beh midresha. amaru leh: avi habben mevarech shetayim. vehilcheta: avi habben mevarech shetayim.
Hadaran alach arve fesachim uselika la massechet pesachim

a: Mishna: beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim veal hakkilayim. uvachamishsha asar bo korin et hammegilla bakkerakkim umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikvot hammayim veosin kol tzorche harabbim umetzayyeynin al hakkevarot veyotzin af al hakkilayim:

Halacha: beechad baadar mashmiin 56. velamma veechad baadar. kede sheyyaviu yisrael et shiklehen beonatan vetittarem terumat hallishka min hachadasha vizmannah beechad benisan. vamar ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak. [terumat hallishka] kattechillatah. [di]chetiv vayhi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan. vetanne alah. bayyom shehukam hammishkan bo vayyom nitrema hatteruma. ribbi tavi ribbi yoshaya veshem kahana. neemar kan chadshe veneemar lehallan chadshe. ma chadshe shenneemar lehallan en monin elle minnisan af chadshe shenneemar kan en monin elle minnisan amar ribbi yona. shevak ribbi tavi roshah veamar sofa. dilo chen kahada detanne. zot olat chodesh bechadsho. yachol tehe torem bechol chodesh vachodesh. talmud lomar bechodsho lechadshe. bechodesh echad hu torem lechol chadshe hashshana. yachol beeze chodesh sheyyirtze. neemar kan chadshe veneemar lehallan chadshe. ma chadshe shenneemar lehallan en monin elle minnisan af chadshe shenneemar kan en monin elle minnisan.
Mahu mashmiin. rav huna amar. machrizin. hech ma deat amar. vayyittenu kol bihuda uvirushalam.

Tamman tanninan. en ben adar harishon laadar hashsheni ella mikra megilla umattanot laevyonim. ribbi simon beshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. af shimmua shekalim vechilayim benehen. ribbi chelbo verav chuna rav beshem ribbi chiyay rabba. hakkol yotzen bearbaa asar shehu zeman keriyaytah. amar ribbi yose. veyeut. kelum amru mashmiin al hashshekalim lo kede sheyyaviu yisrael shiklehen beonatan. im omer at baadar harishon. ad chedon it beshshatta shitin yomin. kelum amru yotzin af al hakkilayim lo kede sheyyehu hatztzemachin nikkarin. im omer at baadar harishon. ad chedon innun dakkikin.

Ribbi chizkiyya shaal. meatta bene vavel mashmiin al shiklehen merosho shelchodesh. lo kede sheyyaviu yisrael shiklehen beonatan vetittarem terumat hallishka min hachadasha vizmannah beechad benisan. hativ ribbi ulla kome ribbi mana. veha tanninan. bishlosha perakim bashshana tormin et hallishka befars happesach befars haatzeret befars hachag. amar leh. nemar. illen dikrevin bifros happesach. illen dirchikin bifros haatzeret. veellin dirchikin minnehon bifros hachag. amar leh. kullah keachat hayta baa. velamma amru bishlosha perakim. kede laasot pompe laddavar.

Ribbi yehuda bar pazi veshem ribbi. hen nikra velo nivhat. letova kol nediv lev. leraa vayyitparku kol haam et nizme hazzahav asher beaznehem. lotova vayyotze moshe et haam. leraa vattikrevun elay kullechem. letova az yashir moshe uvene yisrael. leraa vayyissa kol haeda vayyittenu et kolam. amar ribbi chiyay bar ba. achen hishkimu hishchitu. kol hashechata shehayu osin behashekama hayu osin otah. amar ribbi ba bar acha. en at yachol laamod al ofi shelleumma hazzot. nitbain laegel venotnin. nitbain lammishkan venotnin. tanna ribbi yose ben chanina hada matnita. veasita chapporet zahav tahor. yavo zahav shelkapporet vichapper al zehavo shelegel.

Ribbi chaggay veshem ribbi shemuel bar nachman. shalosh terumot neemru vapparasha hazzot. terumat adanim uterumat shekalim uterumat hammishkan. dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu li teruma zo terumat adanim. meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo tikchu et terumati. zo terumat shekalim. vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam zo terumat hammishkan. terumat hammishkan lammishkan. ma sheyyirtzu yaasu. terumat shekalim lekarban. ma sheyyirtzu yaasu. kede shettehe yad kullan shavav. terumat adanim [laadanim]. heashir lo yarbe vehaddal lo yamit. amar ribbi avun. af bapparasha hazzot neemru vah shalosh terumot.

Bachamishsha asar bo korin et hammegilla bakkerakkim. lo chen amar ribbi chelbo rav chuna rav beshem ribbi chiyay rabba. hakkol yotzen bearbaa asar shehu zeman keriatah. lo va ella lelammedach [shechol] (she)hammitzvot nohagot baadar hashsheni [nohagot baadar harishon]. ribbi yose veribbi acha havon yetivin. amar ribbi yose leribbi acha. lo mistabbera lashsheavar ella lavo. veha tanne. mekom shennahagu likrotah shene yamim korin otah shene yamim. amar leh. of ana sevar ken. amar ribbi mana. veyeut. illu mishshekkerayay baarbaa asar chozer ukerayay bachamishsha asar shemma en shomin lo. im omer at ken nimtzeta oker zeman karachin beyadecha.

Tanne. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer. mitzvot nohagot baadar sheni enan nohagot baadar harishon chutz min hesped umin hattaanit shehen shavin vaze uvaze. ribbi ba ribbi yirmeya veshem rav ribbi simon beshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. halacha cherabban shimon ben gamliel. ribbi chuna rabbah detzipporin amar. hinhig ribbi chanina vetzipporin kehada derabban shimon ben gamliel. lo amar ella hinhig. ha lahalacha lo.
Aval leinyayn shetarot kotvin adar harishon vaadar hashsheni. ella shekkotvin adar hashsheni tinyayn. ribbi yuda omer. adar hashsheni chotev vedayyo.

Metakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikvot hammayim veosin kol tzorche harabbim. ellu hen tzorche harabbim. danin dine mamonot vedine nefashot dine makkot ufodin arachin vacharamin vehekdeshot umashkin et hassota vesorfin et happara veorfin egla arufa verotzin eved ivri umetaharin et hammetzora umefarkin et hamminal meal gabbe haemum veen machazirin oto.
Umetzayyeynin al hakkevarot. lo chevar tziyynu meadar. tiftar sheyyarad shetef shelgeshamim ushetafo.
Veyotzin af al hakkilayim. lo chevar yatzu baadar. tiftar shehayta hashshana afela veen hatztzemachin nikkarin.

Menayin letziyyun. ribbi berechya ribbi yaakov bar bat yaakov veshem ribbi chuneyay divrat chavvran ribbi yose amre lah ribbi yaakov bar acha veshem ribbi chuneyay divrat chavvran ribbi chizkiyya ribbi uzziel bereh deribbi chuneyay devet chavvran beshem ribbi chuneyay devet chavvran. tame tame yikra. kede shettehe hattumea kora lach befiha veomeret lach. perosh. ribbi ila veshem ribbi shemuel bar nachman. veavru haovrim baaretz veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun. michan shemtzayynin al haatzamot. adam. michan shemtzayynin al hashshizra veal haggolgolet. uvana. michan shemtzayynin al gabbe even kevua. im omer at al gabbe even telusha. af hi holechet umetamme vemakom acher. etzlo. limkom tahara. tziyyun. michan letziyyun.

Umatza even achat metzuyenet. af al pi sheen mekayymin ken hammaahil aleha tame. ani omer. met metzuyayn vehaya natun tachteha. hayu shetayim. hammaahil alehen tohor uvenehen tame. im haya choresh bentayim hare hen kichidiyyot. benehen tahor usevivotehen tame.

Tanne en metzayynin al habbasar shemma nitakkel habbasar. ribbi yuseta bar shunem bea kome ribbi mana. velo nimtza metamme taharot lemafrea. amar leh. mottav sheyyitkalkelu vo leshaa veal yitkalkelu vo leolam.
Mishna: amar ribbi yehuda barishona hayu okrin umashlichin lifnehen. mishsherabbu ovre avera hayu okrin umashlichin ladderachim. hitkinu sheyyehu mavkirin et kol hassade.

Halacha: ribbi yehuda omer. tanne amar ribbi yehude. barishona hayu okrin umashlichin lifnehen vehayu semechin shete semachot. achat shehayu menachshin sadotehen veachat shehayu nehenin min (haggezel) [hakkilayim]. mishsherabbu ovre avera hayu mashlichin al hadderachim. af al pi chen hayu semichim shehayu menachshin sadotehen. hitkinu sheyyehu mavkirin et kol hassade.

Minayiyin shehevker bet din hevker. katuv vechol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola. menayin shehi fetura min hammaserot. ribbi yonatan bereh deribbi yitzchak var acha shama lah min hada. en meabberin et hashshana lo vashsheviit velo vemotzae sheviit. veim ibberuha hare zo meubberet. vechodesh echad shehu mosif lo fatur mimmaserot hu. ad chedon sheviit. motzae sheviit [may]. amar ribbi avun. shello lerabbot beissur chadash. ribbi zeura veshem ribbi abbahu. hada deat amar. ad shello hittir ribbi lehavi yarak mechutza laaretz laaretz. aval mishshehittir ribbi lehavi yarak michutz laaretz laaretz hi sheviit hi shel shear shene shavua.

Tanne. en meabberin et hashshana vashsheviit [velo vemotzae sheviit] ella vishar shene shavua. [v]im ibberuha hare ze meubberet. amar ribbi mana. hada deat amar. barishona keshehayu hashshanim ketikunan. aval achshav sheen hashshanim ketikunan hi sheviit hi shear shene shavua. tanne. shelbet rabban gamliel ibberuha vemotzae sheviit miyyad. amar ribbi avun. in min hada let shema minnah chelum. shamor et chodesh haaviv. shamrehu sheyyavo vechiddusho.

Vehey da amra da. gadish shello lukkat tachtav kol hannogot baaretz hare hen shelaniyyim. veamar ribbi immi veshem ribbi shomon ben lakish. devet sammay hi. veamar leh ribbi yose. shamanu shehu fatur mimmaserot divre hakkol mishshum kenas. uchevet hillel aniyim measserin veochlin.

Mishna: bachamishsha ashar bo shulechanot yoshvin bammedina. beeshrim vachamishsha vo yashvu bammikdash. mishsheyyashvu bammikdash hitchilu lemashken. et mi memashkenin leviyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarin aval lo nashim velo avadim velo ketannim. vechol katan shehitchil aviv lishkol al yado eno posek. en memashkenin et hakkohanim mippene darke shalom: amar ribbi yehuda heid ben kuvari beyavne shekkol kohen shehu shokel eno chote. amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay lo ki ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote. ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel hoil vehaomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim shellanu heach hem neechalin:
Halacha: bachamishsha asar bo 56. ha litboa tovin. hada detemar beshehevi shete searot. aval im lo hevi shete searot lo veda. ulemashken en memashkenin ad sheyyavi shete searot.
Keni matnita. en memashkenin et hakkohanim mippene derech hakkavod.

Amar ribbi yehuda heid 56. amar ribbi berechya. taameh derabban yochanan ben zakkay. ze yittenu. shenem asar shevatim yittenu. ribbi tavi veshem rav hamenuna. ken meshivin chachamim leribbi yehuda. chattat yachid meta. en chattat hatztzibbur meta. minchat hayyachid kereva chalil veen minchat tzibbur kereva chalil. vekashya. meshivin laadam davar sheeno mode vo. sheen chattat tzibbur meta. ribbi yehuda omer tamut. vehu motiv lon tu. lo nidvat yachid hi. veinnun metivin leh. mikkevan shennimsera latztzibbur kemi shehi nidvat tzibbur. ketiv kol haover al happekudim. ribbi yuda veribbi nechemya. chad amar. kol daavar bayyamma yitten. vechorana amar. kol daavar al pikkudayay yitten. man daamar kol daavar bayyamma yitten. mesayea lerabban yochanan ben zakkay. man. kol daavar al fikudayay yitten. mesayea leven kovri.

Mishna: af al pi sheamru en memashkenin nashim vaavadim uketannim aval im shaklu mekabbelin miyyadam. hannachri vehakkuti sheshshaklu en mekabbelin miyyadan. veen mekabbelin miyyadan kinne zavin vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot vechattaot vaashamot. ze hakkelal kol shehu niddar veniddav mekabbelin miyyadan. kol sheen lo niddar velo niddav en mekabbelin miyyadan. vechen meforash al yede ezra lo lachem velanu livnot bayit lelohenu: veellu chayayvin bakkollabbon leviyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshucherarin. aval lo kohanim velo nashim velo avadim velo ketannim. hashshokel al yad haeved al yad haishsha al yad hakkohen al yad hakatan patur. al yado veal yad chavero chayayv bekollabbon echad. ribbi meir omer shene kollabbonot. natan sela littol shekel chayayv shene kollabbonot: hashshokel al yad ani val yad shecheno al yad ben iro patur im hilvavm chayayv. haachin hashshutafin shechayayvin bakkollabbon peturin mimmaaser behema veshechayayvin bemasar behema peturin min hakkollabbon. kamma hu kollabbon maa kesef divre ribbi meir vachachamim omrim chatzi maa.
Halacha: af al pi sheamru 56. ha litboa enan tovin. hacha at amar. tovin. vehacha at amar. en tovin kan beshehevi shete searot vechan beshello hevi shete searot.

Hannachri vehakkuti sheshshaklu en mekabbelin miyyadan. amar ribbi ba. tiftar keman deamar. kuti chegoy. deitoppallegon. kuti chegoy. divre ribbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer. kuti cheyisrael lechol davar.

Amar ribbi lazar. matnita vaggoyim. ha vakkutim lo. vetanne chen. adam. lerabbot et haggerim. mikkem. lehotzi et hameshummadim. matnita feliga al ribbi elazar. en mekabbelin miyyadam kinne zavin kinne zavot vekinne yoldot. vechi yesh kinne zavin vezavot vaggoyim. ella resha vaggoyim vesefa vakkutim. veha cheni. resha vaggoyim vesefa vakkutim.

Amar ribbi yochanan. kattechilla en mekabbelin mehen lo davar mesuyaym velo davar sheeno mesuyaym. uvassof mekabbelin mehen davar mesuyaym veen mekabbelin mehen davar sheeno mesuyaym. ribbi shimon ben lakish amar. ben vattechilla ven bassof en mekabbelin mehen lo davar mesuyaym velo davar sheeno mesuyaym. matnita feliga al ribbi yochanan. en mekabbelin mehen hekdesh nedava levedek habbayit. patar lah ben vattechilla ven bassof uvilvad davar sheeno mesuyaym. matnita feliga al ribbi shimon ben lakish. hakkol shavin shehen nodrin veniddarin. patar lah ola. nicha nodrim ola. niddarim ola. lo. besheamar yisrael hare alay ola. usemao goy veamar. ma sheamar ze alay. veeno mevi immah nesachim. umotar nesachim lo lichle sharet innun. nimtza mevi davar mesuyaym. hativ ribbi yose beribbi bun. veha tanninan neerachin. vaarachin lo levedek habbayit innun. hech ma deat amar tamman. lashamayim hu mitkavven umeelehen hen bain levedek habbayit. ken at amar af hacha. lashamayim hu mitkavven umeelehen hen bain lichle sharet. ma avad lah ribbi shimon ben lakish. patar lah lo lachem velanu livnot bayit lelohenu. ribbi chilkiyya amar. ribbi simon shaal. meatta en mekabbelin mehen [la]ammat hammayim u[l]chomat hair umigdeloteha. al shem velchem en chelek utzedaka vezikkaron birushala͏m.

Ellu chayayvin bakkollabbon 56. matnita deribbi meir. deribbi meir amar. af al pi sheen shiklo tora kollabbono tora. savar ribbi meir benoten shiklo shalem shehu fatur min hakkollabbon. amar ribbi meir. kemin matbea shelesh hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu mittachat kisse chevodo vehareahu lemoshe. emar lo. ze yittenu. kaze yittenu.

Natan sela littol shekel chayayv shene kollabbonot. amar ribbi lazar. deribbi meir hi. deribbi meir amar. echad shekel shehu noten veechad sela shehu notel. rav amar. divre hakkol hi. echad shekel shehu [noten veechad shekel shehu] notel veechad lidvar tora. al dateh derav shelosha kollabbonot innun. ata ribbi yirmeya ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak beshem rav. shelosha kollabbonot innun. echad shekel shehu noten veechad shekel shehu notel veechad lidvar tora.
Haachin vehashshuttafin shechayayvin bakkollabbon ufeturin bemmasar behema. beshechilku vechazru venishtattefu. shechayayvin bemasar behema ufeturin min hakkollabbon. beshello chilleku.

Hashshokel al yede ani 56. amar ribbi lazar. vehen shechilku gedayim keneged teyayshim uteyayshim keneged gedayim. aval im chilku gedayim keneged gedayim uteyayshim keneged teyayshim hu chelko mishshaa harishona. amar ribbi yochanan. vaafilu chilku gedayim keneged gedayim uteyayshoym keneged teyyshim kilkuchot hen. kahi detanninan tamman. hallakuach ushennittan lo mattana patur mimmasar behema. ribbi chizkiyya amar. ribbi yirmeya vae. velamma le nan amrin. peamim shechayayvin baze uvaze ufeamim shehen feturin mizze umizze. hech avida. chilku et hannechasim veachar kach chilku et habbehema. chayayvin baze uvaze. chilku et habbehema veachar kach chilku et hannechasim. feturin mizze umizze. amar ribbi mana. hada deatt amar. beshello hayta habbehema rov. aval im hayta habbehema rov hen hen ikkar nechasav. ribbi abbun amar. ribbi shammay vae. mippene sheasitan [keadam echad] (keechad adam) etzel maaser vehema at fotro min hakkollavon. amar leh lo. shanyay hi shehu noten sela achat shelema. meatta afilu chilleku vechazru venishtattefu chayayvin bemaasar behema ufeturin min hakkolabbon. vetanninan. chayayvin bakkollabbon ufeturin mimmaasar behema. ribbi ba veshem abba bar rav huna. hi shene achin sheyyarshu et avihen hi shene gisin sheyyarshu et chamehen.

Leechan hayu hakkollabbonot noflin. ribbi meir omer. lashshekalim. ribbi lazar omer. lindava. ribbi shimon hashshezuri omer. rikkue zahav vetzippuy levet kodesh hakkadashim. ben azzay omer. sholchanin hayu notlin otan bischaran. veyesh omrim. lehotzaat derachim.

Mishna: metzarfin shekalim darkonot mippene massoy hadderech. keshem shehayu shofarot bammikdash kakk hayu bammedina. bene hair sheshshilchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavdu im nitrema hatteruma nishbain laggizbarim veim lav nishbain livne hair uvene hair shoklin tachtehen. nimtzau o shehechezirum haggannavim ellu vaellu shekalim veen olin lahen leshana habbaa:

Halacha: metzarfin shekalim darkonot 56. veyaasu otan margalit. shemme tazil hammargalit venimtza hahekdesh mafsid. kahi detanninan tamman. vechullan nifdin bechesef uveshave chesef chutz min hashshekalim. [veen podin bechelim]. amar ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak. shemma yazilu hakkelim venimtza hahekdesh mafsid. vehacha shemma tazil hammargalit venimtza hahekdesh mafsid.

Matnita vitkelin chaddetin. aval bitkelin attikin la veda. vetanne chen. attikin bammikdash. en attikin bammedina. matnita vishomer chinnam. aval beshomer sachar lo veda. amar rav abba. vaafilu temar beshomer sachar. nignevu. belestes mezuyayn. avdu. kemi shettava sefinnato vayyam. amar ribbi yuseta beribbi simon. atyay keman deamar. tormin al haggavuy veal heatid lehiggavot. beram keman deamar. en tormin lo al haggavuy velo al hamemushekan. lo veda.

Bene hair sheshshilchu et shiklehen. nignevu o sheavdu. amar ribbi elazar. deribbi shimon hi. deribbi shimon amar. kodashim shehu chayayv baacheriyyutan kinchasav hen. amar ribbi yochanan. divre hakkol hi. mishshum shevuat takkana. al dateh deribbi yochanan nicha. nishbain livne hair uvene hair shoklin tachtehen. hada hi deribbi shimon. mishshem shevuat takkana. af al pi shekkibbelu vene hair leshallem en hahekdesh yotze velo shevua.

Hifrish shiklo veavad. ribbi yochanan amar. chayyyyav baacherayuto ad sheyyimsor laggizbar. ribbi shimon ben lakish amar. hekdesh birshut haggavoah bechol makom shehu. matnita feliga al ribbi shimon ben lakish. nishbain livne hair uvene hair shoklin tachtehen. [od] hi mishshem shevuat takkana.

Tanne harishonim noflin letkelin chaddetin vehashsheniyim noflim letiklin atikin. ellu hen harishonim veellu hen hashsheniyim. ribbi pinchas beribbi chananya veribbi abba mari. chad amar. ellu sheshshilchu vene hair techilla. vechorana amar. ellu shehiggiu lide gizbarin techilla.

Mishna: hannoten shiklo lachavero lishkol al yado ushekalo al yede atzmo im nitrema hatteruma maal. hashshokel shiklo min hahekdesh venitrema hatteruma vekarva habbehema maal. mimmaasher sheni umiddeme sheviit yochal kenegdan:

Halacha: hashshokel 56. anan tanninan. im nitrema hatteruma. vetanney devet ribbi im karva habbehema. amar ribbi lazar. man tanna. im karva habbehema. ribbi shimon. deribbi shimon omer. miyyad haya mekabbel maotav. hakkohanim zerizin hen. vekashya. illu haggonev olato shelchavero ushechatah setam. setammah lo leshem habbealim harishonim mechapperet. amar ribbi yudan. tiftar bimsuyaym. mishshelbet rabban gamliel shehaya mitkavven udechafo lakkuppa. vechash lomar. shemma lashirayim hen noflin. vechi yesh meila beshirayim. ella cheribbi meir. deribbi meir amar. moalin beshirayim. od hi bimsuyaym. mishshelbet rabban gamliel shehaya mitkavven vetormo lishmo.
Ma nehene. amar ribbi abbin beshem rabbanin detamman. mikkevan shebbet din reuyin lemashken velo mishkeno kemi shennehene.

Katuv ach bechor asher yevukkar layy bivhema lo yakdish ish oto. kol shehu kodesh en kedoshsha chala alav. ketzad hu ose. mevi sela shelchulin veomer. maot maaser sheni bechol makom shehen mechulalin al sela zo veotan nitpassin leshem sheni vehashshear naasin shekalim.

Mishna: hamechannes maot veamar hare ellu leshikli bet shammay omrim motaran nedava. uvet hillel omrim motaran chulin. sheavi mehen shikli shavin shemmotaran chulin. ellu lechattat shavin shehammotar nedava. sheavi mehen chattati shavin shehammotar chulin: amar ribbi shimon ma ben shekalim lechattat. ella shel shekalim yesh lahen kitzva ulechattat en lah kitzva. ribbi yehuda omer af lishkalim en lahen kitzva shekkeshealu yisrael min haggola hayu shoklin darkonot chazru lishkol selaim chazru lishkol tivim bikkeshu lishkol dinarin. amar rabbi shimon af al pi chen yad kullam shavav. aval chattat ze mevi besela veze mevi bishtayim veze mevi beshalosh:

Halacha: hamechannes maot 56. ribbi yose veshem ribbi lazar. ma feloygin. bimchannes perotrot. aval baomer. ellu [leshikli]. kol amma modey shehammotar nedava. ribbi chizkiyya ribbi bevay beshem ribbi lazar. ma feligin. bimchannes perotrot. aval baomer. ellu. kol amma modey shehammotar chulin. amar ribbi chizkiyya. matnita mesayya leribbi bevay. [ditnan.] amar rabbi shimon. ma ben shekalim lechattat. ella shehashshekalim yesh lahen kitzva ulechattat en lah kitzva. ma anan kayaymin. im baomer. sheavi mehen shikli. kol amma modey shehammotar chulin. im baomer. sheavi mehem chattati kol amma modey shehammotar nedava. ella chen anan kayaymin. baomer. ellu shekalim. al yede shekitzvavtan min hattora. motaran chulin. chattat al yede sheyn kitzvatah min hattora. motarah nedava. ma avad lah ribbi shimon ben lakish. patar lah bimchannes perotrot kevet hillel. veha tanninan. motar shekalim chullin. patar lah bimchannes perotrot uchevet hillel. veha tanninan. asirit haefa [chulin]. od hu patar lah bimchannes perotrot uchevet hillel.

Hammafrish shiklo vesavur shehu chayayv venimtza sheeno chayayv. lo kadash. hammafrish shenayim vesavur shehu chayayv shenayim venimtza sheeno chayayv ella echad. oto hashsheni ma at avad leh. [nishmeinah min hada. hifrish chattato] savur shehu chayayv venimtza sheeno chayayv. lo kadsha. hifrish shetayim vesavur shehu chayayv shetayim venimtza sheeno chayayv ella achat. otah hashsheniyay ma at avad lah. (baomer) [ella roa. hacha namme ellu lindava. heach atta omer] ellu.

Shekkeshealu yisrael min haggola hayu shoklin darkonot. denarin. chazru leshkol selaim. kishmuan. chazru lishkol tivin. palge silin. bikkeshu lishkol dinarin. karatin. velo kibbelu alehen. min hada. veheemadnu alenu mitzvot latet shelishit hashshekel bashshana laavodat bet elohenu. ribbi chilkiyya veshem ribbi acha. mikkan sheadam tzarich leshallesh shiklo shelosha feamim bashshana. mikkan sheen matrichin al hatztzibbur yoter mishshelosha feamim bashshana. amar ribbi abbin. mikkan leshalosh sein. mikkan leshalosh kuppot. mikkan leshalosh afrashot.

Ketiv ze yittenu kol haover al happekudim vegomer. ribbi yuda veribbi nechemya. chad amar. lefi shechatu vemachatzit hayyom yitnu machatzit hashshekel. vecharana amar. lefi shechatu veshesh shaot yitnu machatzit hashshekel daavad shitta gerammasin. ribbi yehoshua beribbi nechemya veshem rabban yochanan ben zakkayy. lefi sheibberu al aseret haddibberot yehe noten kol echad veechad aseret gera. ribbi berechya ribbi levi veshem ribbi shimon ben lakish. lefi shemmachru vechorah shel rachel beesrim kesef yehe chol echad veechad [fode et] beno vechoro boesrim kesef. ribbi pinchas beshem ribbi levi. lefi shemmachru vechorah shel rachel beesrim kesef venafal lechol echad veechad mehen tibba lefichach yehe chol echad veechad noten shiklo tibba.

Mishna: motar shekalim chulin. motar asirit haefa motar kinne zavim kinne zavot kinne yoldot chattaot vaashamot motaran nedava. ze hakkelal kol shehu ba leshem chett vmishshem ashma motaran nedava. motar ola laola. motar mincha lammincha. motar shelamim lashshelamim. motar pesach lashshelamim. motar nezirim lannezirim. motar nazir lannedava.

Halacha: motar shekalim chulin 56. amar ribbi yosa. ad daana tamman shemait kal rav yehuda sheal lishmuel. hifrish shiklo vamet. amar leh. yippelu lindava. motar asirit haefa shello. ribbi yochanan amar. yolichem leyam hammelach. ribbi lazar amar. yippelu lindava. matnita feliga al ribbi yochanan. motar shekalim chulin. motar asirit haefa motar kinne zavim kinne zavot motar kinne yoldot chattaot vaashamot motaran nedava. ma avad lah ribbi yochanan. patar lah motar asirit haefa shelminchat chote shelkol yisrael.

Ribbi yochanan amar. al daali abba bar ba. deinnun amrin. menayin shehappesach mishtanne leshem shelamim. talmud lomar. im min hatztzon karbano lezevach shelamim. kol shehu min hatztzon ba shelamim. hativun. hare ola min hatztzon. davar sheeno va ella min hatztzon. yatzat ola shehi vaa afilu min habbakar. hativun. hare asham. amar ribbi bun bar kahana. min hatztzon. davar shehu ba mikkol hatztzon. yatza asham sheeno va ella min haelim bilvad. bechol atar at amar. (millerabbot) [min lemaet]. vehacha at amar. (millemaet) [lerabbot]. amar ribbi mana. (miato) [hacha namme min lemaet. miot sheeno va ben shene shanim. miot sheeno va nekeva. vegabbe asham namme min lemaet hu.] sheeno va ella min haelim bilvad. hativun. vehachtiv veim min hatztzon karbano min hakkesavim o min haizzim leola. meatta motar happesach ba ola. amar ribbi abbun. meshannin davar shehu laachila ledavar shehu laachila veen meshannin davar shehu laachila ledavar sheeno laachila. amar ribbi yose beribbi bun. meshannin kodashim kallim leshem kodashin kallin veen meshannin kodashim kallin leshem kadshe kadashim. ribbi yochanan amar. al daali ribbi chanina. deinnun amrin. en happesach mishtanne leshem shelamim ella im ken shechato leshem shelamim. vaani omer. afilu shechato leshem ola. amar ribbi ila. taameh deribbi yochanan. im min hatztzon karbano lezevach shelamim. kol shehu zevach ba shelamim. umishtanne lemachashevet pesul. hech avida. shechato leshem ola al menat lizrok damo lemachar. mikkol makom pasul hu. in temar. mishtanne lemachashevet pesul. piggul. in temar. eno mishtanne lemachashevet pesul. fasul.

Lishmo veshello lishmo bishar yemot hashshana. ribbi bun bar chiyay veshem shemuel bar abba. mikkevan sheen lo shem naase cheshochto lishmo veshello lishmo vishtika vehu chasher. amru leh. veim ken hu afilu shechato lishmo lizrok damo shello lishmo yease mishshaa harishona cheshochto lishmo veshello lishmo vihe chasher. amar ribbi abba mari. man amar bishtika chasher. o nomar. bishtika pasul.

Rav chisda amar. vehu shekkarva chattato vassof. aval im karvu shelamim bassof motaran shelamim. amar ribbi zeura. vaafilu karvu shelamim bassof halacha achat hi venazir shettehe motarah nedava. matnita mesayya leden umatnita mesayya leden. matnita mesayya leribbi zeura. afilu hen maot setumin. kol sheddeme chattaot metot meuravot bahen. vaafilu hifrish deme chattaot metot mittochah maot setumin hen. matnita mesayya lerav chisda. ellu lechattati vehashshear lishar neziruti. vamet. moalin bechullan veen moalin miktzatan. velo amar. im matti yippelu lindava.

Rav chisda amar. motar lachmo shelnazir yirkav. amar ribbi yose. veyeut. lehakerivo vifne atzmo en yachol. sheen lecha lechem karev leatzmo. lehakerivo im nezirut acheret en at yachol. sheen lach nezirut baa velo lechem. lefum ken tzarich memar motar lachmo shelnazir yirkav. savrin memar. hu lachmo hu motar nesachav. amar ribbi yose beribbi bun. motar nesachav kadshe kadashem innun veyippelu lindeva. al dateh deribbi yose beribbi bun. shemuel verav chisda veribbi elazar shelashtan amru davar echad. rav chisda ahen dehacha. shemuel deamar ribbi yasa. ad daana tamman shemait kal rav yehuda sheal lishmuel. hifrish shiklo vamet. amar leh. yippelu lindava. ribbi lazar. motar asirit haefa shello. ribbi yochanan amar. yolichem leyam hammelach. ribbi lazar amar. yippelu lindava.

Mishna: motar shevuyim lashshevuyim motar shavuy leoto shavuy. motar aniyyim laaniyyim motar ani leoto ani. motar hammetim lammetim motar hammet leyorshav. ribbi meir omer motar hammet yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyahu. ribbi natan omer motar hammet bonin lo nefesh al kivro:

Halacha: gavu lo bechezkat sheen lo venimtza sheyyesh lo. ribbi yirmeya sevar memar. motar hammet leyorshav. amar leh ribbi idi dechutereh. hagga atzmach dela chivvnun ella [leh. amar] leh. ana [la] amrit. at menan lach.

Tanne veshem ribbi natan. motar hammet yivne lo nefesh al kivro veyaase lo (zalech) [zilluf] al gabbe mittato. tanne en podin shavuy veshavuy veen govin tallit vetallit. veen mamchin beyad parnasin lechach. tanne. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer. en osin nefashot latztzaddikim. divrehen hen zichronan.

[Ribbi yochanan hava masmich veazil al ribbi chiyay bar abba vahava ribbi eliezer chami leh umittammer leh mikkamme vaamar. halen tarten millayya haden bavlaa avid beh. chada dela sheil bishlomeh vechada mittamar. amar leh ribbi yaakov bar idi kach nahagin gabbehon. zeira la sheil bishlumeh derabba. deinnun nehigin umekayymin rauni nearim venechbau vishishim kamu amadu. amar leh. mahu lemeavad kamme daarura tzilma. amar leh. ma at pelig leh yekar. avor kammohi vesammi enoyy. amar leh. yeut ribbi eliezer avud dela avar kammach. veod avid ha bavlaa dela amar shemata mishshemeh. nichnesu lefanav ribbi immoy veribbi assi. amru lo. ribbi. kach haya maase bet hakkeneset shel tarsiyyim haya benaggar sheyyesh verosho gelusetra. shennechleku ribbi elazar veribbi yose ad shekkaru sefer tora vachammatan. vekaru salka datach. ella shenikra sefer tora. vehaya sham zaken echad. veribbi yose ben kisma. amar. temohani im lo hava bet hakkeneset ze avoda zara. vechazar veamar. hachden mechavreh. nichnas lefanav ribbi yaakov bar idi. amar lo ketiv kol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe avdo ken tzivva yehoshua vegomer. vechi chol dibbur vedibbur shehaya yehoshua yoshev vedoresh haya omer. kach amar moshe. ella yehoshua yoshev vedoresh veyodin shehattora shel moshe hi. af atta elazar yoshev vedoresh. hakkol yodin shettora shellach hi. amar lahen. mippene ma e attem yodin laratztzot keven idi chaverenu.

Veribbi yochanan may chulle hay. devae deyemrun shemata mishshemeh. deaf david bikkesh aleha rachamim. shenneemar agura veahalcha olamit echese veseter kenafecha sela. vechi alta al dato shel david sheyyehe chay vekayaym leolamim. ella chach amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu. ribbono shel olam. ezke sheyyehu devarayy neemarin bevatte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot. shimon ben nezira veshem ribbi yitzchak amar. kel talmid chacham sheomrim devar halacha mippiv vaolam hazze sefatav rochashot immo vakkever. shenneemar dovev sifte yeshenim. ma chomer shel anavim ze kevan shemmanniach adam etzbao alav miyyad dovev af sifottotehem shel tzaddikim kevan sheomrin devar halacha mippihem shel tzaddikim siftotehen merachashot immahen vakkever. ma hanaa lo. bar nezira amar. kehaden deshate konditon. ribbi yitzchak amar. kehaden deshat chamar atik. af al gav delet leh taama.

Giddul amar. kan shemua veshem omrah yire baal shemua keillu omed lenegdo. shenneemar ach betzelem yithallech ish. rov adam yikra et ish chasdo. ze shear kol adam. veish emunim mi yimtza. ze ribbi zeira. deamar ribbi zeira. lamma li sheani tzerichin rechushin lishmateh derav sheshet dehu gavra mefatcha. amar leh ribbi zeira leribbi assi. chachim ribbi levar patyay deata amar semuata mishshemeh. amar leh ribbi yochanan amrah mishmeh. amar leh ribbi zeira leribbi assi. chachim ribbi lerav deatt amar semuata mishshemeh. amar leh. rav ada bar ahava amran mishshemeh.

En dor sheen bo letzanin. bedoro shel david me hayu ferutze haddor osin. hayu holchim etzel chalonotav shel david. omrin lo. david david. ematay yibbane vet hammikdash. ematay bet Adonai nelech. vehay david omer. af al pi shemitkavvnin lehacheiseni yavou alay im lo hayiti sameach vedivrehem. dichtiv samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nelech. vehaya ki yimleu yamecha veshachavta im avotecha. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ledavid. yamim shelemim ani mone lecha velo yamim chaserim. kelum shelomo vincha yivne vet hammikdash ella lehakeriv karbenot tzibbur. chaviv alay tzedaka umishpat sheatta ose yoter min hakkarban. shenneemar ase tzedaka umishpat nivchar laAdonai mizzavach.]

Mishna: bishlosha perakim bashshana tormin et hallishka befars happesach befars atzeret befars hechag vehen geranot shel masar behema divre ribbi akiva. ben azzay omer beesrim vetisha baadar beechad besivan beesrim vetisha beav. ribbi lazar veribbi shimon omrim beechad benisan beechad besivan beesrim vetisha beelul. velamma amru beesrim vetisha beelul velo amru beechad betishre mippene shehu yom tov vee efshar leasser beyom tov lefichach hikdimuhu beesrim vetisha beelul:
Halacha: bishlosha perakim bashshana chul. amar ribbi abbahu. kol hen detanninan pars palga. [palga vishloshim yom kodem lammoed sheddorshin behilchotav.]

Amar ribbi yochanan. mippene shehen pirke leda. ribbi acha ribbi tanchum bar chiyay veshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. kede shettahe vehema metzuya leole regalim. emar ribbi yudan. shello yavo lide bal taacher. amar ribbi yose. kol hammashhe tivlo over. tamman tanninan. rabbi meir omer. beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. ben azzayy omer haeluliyyim mitashsherin bifne atzman. amar ribbi chuna. taameh deribbi meir. ad kan hen mitmatztzot leled men hayyeshanot. mikkan veelach hen matchilot leled min hachadashot. ribbi yose beribbi bun beshem rav chuna. taameh deribbi elazar veribbi shimon. lavshu charim hatztzon ellu habbechirot. vaamakim yaatfu var ellu haafelot. yitroau af yashiru. ellu vaellu nichnasin laddir lehitasser. amar ben azzay. hoil veellu omrim kach veellu omrim kach yehu haeluleyim mitashsherin bifne atzman. ha chetzad. nolad lo vachamishsha veav vachamishsha veelul vachamishsha vetishre en mitztarfin. nolad lo chamishsha veav vachamishsha vetishre hare ellu mitztarfin. uven azzay machria al divre talmidav. ribbi yirmeya ribbi mayysha veshem ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak. shekken nechleku aleha avot haolam. man innun avot haolam. tanna ribbi yona kome ribbi yirmeya. ribbi yishmael veribbi akiva. zot omeret. ben azzay chaver vetalmid haya deribbi akiva. in temar rabbeh. it bar nash amar lerabbeh. hoil veellu omrim kach veellu omrim kach. ribbi avun beshem ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak shama lah min hada. amar lo ben azzay. al chalukin anu mitztaarin ella shebbata lachalok alenu et hashshavin. zot omeret. ben azzay chaver vetalmid hava leribbi akiva. in temar rabbeh. it bar nash amar lerabbeh. ella shebbata lachalok alenu.

Tamman tanninan. kol hannoladin beechad betishre ad esrim vetisha beelul hare ellu mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana en mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren hare ellu mitztarfin. amar ribbi yose. zot omeret. maaser behema lo asu oto lo chechenet velo chishlish. in temar kechenet. nitne kol hameubbarin meesrim vetisha vaelul. in temar kishlish. nitne kol hannoladin ad esrim ushenayim bo. ribbi shammay veshem ribbi bun bar chiyay. kishlish asu oto cheribbi shimon. deribbi shimon amar. mechossar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser. kam ribbi mana im ribbi shammay. amar leh. atta amarta hada milleta. amar leh. in. amar leh. vehatanninan. ben azzay omer. haeluliyyim mitasserin bifne atzman. lo afilu nolad ad esrim vetisha beelul. it lach memar ben azzay cheribbi shimon. lo cherabbanin hi. kema deat amar al derabbanin. mannichan lashshana habbaa vehen mitasserin im bene shenatan. ken at amar al deven azzay. mannichan laggoren habba vehen mitasserin im bene elul. amar ribbi chuna. zot omeret. yamim shehabbechor mechossar zeman bahen olin lo mittoch shenato. amar ribbi mana. ribbi yona abba shema lah min hada. kol habbechor asher yivvaled bivkarcha uvetzoncha hazzachar vegomer. ha chetzad. mishsheat ledato at mone lo shana.

Mishna: beshalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein tormin et hallishka vechatuv bahen alef 412 83. ribbi yishmael omer yevanit katuv bahen 112 413 74. en hattorem nichnas lo befaraggod chafut velo beminal velo besandal velo bitfilla velo bekamia shemma yaani viyomru meavon hallishka heeni o shemma yaashir veyomru mitterumat hallishka heeshir. sheadam tzarich latzet yede habbiryyot kederech shetztzarich latzet yede hammakom shenneemar vihyitem nekiyim meAdonai umiyyisrael veomer umetza chen vesechel tov beene elohim veadam:

Halacha: [ribbi zeura shaal ribbi oshayya. kamma hu shiuran shell shalosh kufot. amar leh. nilmod satum min hameforash. tanne.]. beshalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein shehen tisha sein shehen esrim vesheva sein tormin et hallishka vechatuv alehen alef bet gimel. mippene ma chatuv alehen alef bet gimel. lomar. en mistappek min harishona kodem lashsheniyay velo mishsheniyay kodem lashshelishit.

[Tamman tanninan hammotzi yayn kede mezigat hakkos. ribbi zeoyra sheil et ribbi yoshiyyahu. kamma ha shiuran shel kos. amar leh. nilmad satum min hameforash. detanne ribbi chiyay. arbaa chusut sheamru yeshnan reviit yayin haitalki.

Hakkus mazug bechamma. amar ribbi yuse bar bevin mishshum ribbi yochanan. nishmeinan min hada. mayim kede gemia. ribbi yehuda omer. kede mezigat hakkos. yayn kede gemia. ribbi yehuda omer. kede mezigat hakkos. hada amra. mazug kede mezigat hakkos. kamma shiuran shel kosot. ribbi avun amar. tevtratoyn urevia.

Mahu lishtotan becherech echad. middeamar ribbi meir amar ribbi yochanan. hallel im shamaan bevet hakkeneset yatza. hada amra. im shetaan becherech echad yatza. mahu lishtotan befisakin. kelum amru sheyyishtu lo kede sheyyishtanne velo yishtakker. im shata vefisakin af hu eno mishtakker. mahu latzet beyayin shel sheviit. tanna rav oshaya. yotzin beyayin shell sheviit. mahu latzet bekonditon. midtanne bar kappara. konditon keyayin. hada amra. yotzin beyen konditon. mahu letzet beyayin mezugin. middetanne ribbi chiyay. arbaa chusut sheamru yotzin bahen ben chayin uven mezugin uvillevad sheyyehe vahen taam umare yayin. amar ribbi yirmeya. mitzva latzet beyayin adom. shenneemar al tere yayin ki yitaddam ki yitten bakkosenu vegomer. tanne. mevushshal kimtubbel. mahu latzet beyayin mevushshal. amar ribbi yona. yotzin beyayin mevushshal. ribbi yona letaameh. deribbi yona kad hava shati arba chasse defischa hava chazzuk resheh ad chagga.

Chamitteh chada matronita appoy nehorin. amra. sabba sabba. chada mehane telat milla it bach. o dishtuye chamra at o demalve veribbit at o dimgaddel chazire at. amar lah. tippach rucha dehahi ittata. dechada mehalen telat millayay let ban. ella ulepan dishchicha leh. dehachen ketiv chachmat adam tair panav.

Ribbi abbahu ati letibberyya. chemoney talmidoy deribbi yochanan appoy nehirin. amrun talmivdoyy leribbi yochanan. ashkach ribbi abbahu simon. ata legabbeh. amar leh. may chaddeta shemata. amar leh. tosefta attika. kera aleh. chachmat adam tair panav.

Amar ribbi chanan. loga deorayta tomanya attika demmuriyesa detzippori. amar ribbi yona. vachachimna leh. devet shammay hava mechilin vah devash. tanne. chatzi sheminit tibbernit. amar ribbi yochanan. chada didan hava. velamma kari lah attika. min begin dahava veyoma. it deamre. dahava zeira veravat. veit deamre. deazira azarat kome dahava. kamma hu shiuran shell kos. ribbi yose veshem ribbi yose ben pazi veribbi yuse bar bevin beshem ribbi shemuel. etzbaayim al etzbaayim al rum etzba umechetza ushelish etzba. rabbanin dekaysarin veribbi yose bar bevin beshem shemuel. atya deribbi natan keribbi shimon. kemo deribbi shimon amar. barvia. ken amar ribbi natan. barvia. lichsheyykrash vihe vu chezayit.

Ribbi simon beshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. maase vefirdat ribbi shemmeta. vetiharu et damah mishshum nevela. veshaal ribbi elazar et ribbi simon. ad kamma. velo ashgach beh. veshaal leh ribbi yehoshua ben levi deamar leh. ad reviit tahor. yoter mikken tame. uveat ribbi elazar ad dela achzar leh ribbi simon shemata. rav beva hava yetiv matnu haden ovda. amar leh ribbi yitzchak bar bisna. ad reviit tahor. yoter mikken tame. uveit beh. amar leh ribbi zerika. begin dishal lach at beat beh. amar leh. begin dela havat dati bi baitna veh. deamar ribbi chanan. vehayu chayyecha teluim lecha minnegode. ze shellokeach chittim lashshana. ufachadta layla veyomam. ze shellokeach min [hatztzidaki]. velo taamin bechayyecha. ze shellokeach min happaltar. vaana semichna appaltar. umahu chedi. heid ribbi yehoshua ben petora al dam nevela shehu tahor. ma letahor. letaher min habbasar. ha letamme atta metamme. tamman tannina. dam hashsheretz kivsaro metamme veen machshir. veen lanu kayyotze vo. veshiur tumeato sheddamo metamme kivsaro. amar rav yose peligin bah teren amorain chad amar. tame. vechad amar. tahor. man deamar tame. keribbi yehuda. uman tahor. keribbi yehoshua ben petora. rav avuha deiman achteh deribbi yehuda moryayna denasi hava.]

[Shemma yaani veyomru vechulei.] tanne ribbi yishmael. kivevtz lo yitrom mippene hachashad. tanne. haggizberin hayu mefaspesin bekillikin. tanne medabberin hayu immo mishshaa shehu nichnas ad shaa shehu yotze. vimalle pumeh moy. amar ribbi tanchuma. mippene habberacha.

Ribbi shemuel bar nachman beshem ribbi yonatan. battora uvanneviym uvakketovim matzanu sheadam tzarich latzet yede habbiryot kederech shehu tzarich latzet yede hammakom. battora menayin. dichtiv vihyitem nekiyim meAdonai umiyyisrael. banneviym menayin. dichtiv el elohim Adonai el elohim Adonai hu yovodea veyisrael hu yeda. bakketovim menayin. shenneemar umetza chen vesechel tov beene elohim veadam. gamliel zeuga shaal leribbi yose beribbi bun. e zehu hamechuvar shebbechullan. amar leh. vihyitem nekiyim meAdonai umiyyisrael.

Mishna: shel bet rabban gamliel haya nichnas veshiklo ben etzbeotav vezorko lifne hattorem vehattorem mitkavven vedochako lakkuppa. en hattorem torem ad sheyyomar lahen etrom. vehen omrim lo terom, terom, terom, shalosh peamim: taram et harishona vechippa biktavoliyyot hashsheniyay vechippa biktavoliyyot. hashshelishit lo haya mechappe. velamma haya mechappe shemma yishkach veyitrom min haddavar hattarum. taram et harishona leshem eretz yisrael hashsheniyay leshem kerachim hammukkafin lah vehashshelishit leshem bavel uleshem maday uleshem medinot harchokot:

Halacha: shel bet rabban gamliel haya 56. illu shene cheriyim vetaram meechad mehen al chavero shemma lo fatar chavero. hannachat ruach hi lahem shello yehe karban mitkarev ella mishshellahen techilla.
Taram et harishona 56. tanne shamat et hakkatovoliyyot naasu chullan sheyeriym. tanne. shelishit hi hayta ashira shebbechullan. shehayu vah itztele shelzahav vedarchonot shelzahav.

Tanne. taram et harishona leshem eretz yisrael uleshem kol yisrael. sheniyay leshem karachin hammukkafin uleshem kol yisrael. vehashshelishit leshem bavel uleshem madayy uleshem medinut harchokot uleshem kol yisrael. tanne. natal min harishona af al pi sheyyesh barishona notel min hashsheniyay. natal min hashsheniyay af al pi sheyyesh bashsheniyay notel min hashshelishit. shalma shelishit chozer lashsheniyay. shalma sheniyay chozer lerishona. shalmu shelashtan chozer veshokel. ribbi meir omer. chozer lishyeriym. shehaya ribbi meir omer. moalin bishyeriyim shemma yitzrechu lahen bassof.

[Vechen haya ribbi finchas ben yair omer. zerizut mevia lide nekiyyut. nekiyyut mevia lide tahora. tahora mevia lide kedushsha. kedushsha mevia lide anava. anava mevia lide yirat chet. yirat chet mevia lide chasidut. chasidut mevia lide ruach hakkodesh. ruach hakkodesh mevi lide techiyayt hammetim. techiyayt hammetim mevia lide eliyyahu zachur lattov. zerizut mevia lide nekiyyut. dichtiv vechilla mikkapper. nekiyyut mevia lide tahora. dichtiv vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera. tahora mevia lide kedushsha. dichtiv vetiharah vekiddeshah. kedushsha mevia lide anava. dichtiv ki cho mar ram venissa shochen ad vekadosh shemo marom… veet dakka ushefal ruach. anava mevia lide yirat chet. dichtiv anava yirat Adonai. yirat chet mevia lide chasidut. dichtiv vechesed Adonai meolam vead olam al yereav. chasidut mevia lide ruach hakkodesh. dichtiv az dibbarta vechazon lachasidecha. ruach hakkodesh mevi lide techiyayt hammetim. dichtiv venatatti ruchi vachem vichyitem. techiyayt hammetim mevia lide eliyyahu zachur lattov. dichtev az tavin yirat Adonai vedaat elyon timtza. tana veshem ribbi meir. kol mi shekkavua beeretz yisrael umedabber leshon hakkodesh veochel perotav betohora vekore kiryat shema babboker uvaerev yehe mevussar shebben haolam habba hu.]

Mishna: hatteruma me hayu osin bah. lokchin bah temidin umusafin veniskehem haomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim vechol karbenot hatztzibbur. shomre sefichim bashsheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. ribbi yose omer af harotze mitnaddev shomer chinnam. amru lo af atta omer sheen bain ella mishshel tzibbur:

Halacha: hatteruma me hayu osin bah 56. ma raa zeman atze chohanim vehaam lehimmanot. ella veshaa shealu yisrael min haggola velo matzu etzim ballishka veamdu ellu venitnaddevu etzim mishshelatzman umesarum latztzibbur vekarvu mehen karbenot tzibbur. vehitnu immahen hanneviym shebbenehen sheafilu lishka melea etzim veamdu ellu venitnaddevu etzim mishshelatzman shello yihe karban mitkarev ella mishshellahen techilla. amar ribbi acha. deribbi yose hi. deribbi yose amar. af harotze mitnaddev shomer chinnam. ribbi yose veshem ribbi ila. divre hakkol hi. ma feligin. begufo shelkarban. aval bemachshire karban kol amma modey shehu mishtanne karban yachid lekarban tzibbur. tanne. [i]sha sheasat kuttonet livnah tzericha limsor letzibbur. amar ribbi acha. deribbi yose hi. deribbi yose amar. af harotze mitnaddev shomer chinnam. ribbi yose veshem ribbi ila. divre hakkol hi. ma feligin. begufo shelkarban. aval bemachshire karban kol amma modey shehu mishtanne karban yachid lekarban tzibbur. matnita feliga al ribbi yose. otan hayyamim nohagin bishat karban veshello bishat karban. ribbi yose omer. enan nohagin ella bishat karban. veod min hada detanne. amar ribbi elazar beribbi tzadok. anu hayinu mibbene senaa ven binyamin vechal tisha veav lihyot bashshabbat vedachinu oto lemotzae shabbat vehayinu mitannin velu mashlimin.

Haomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim. matnita deribbi yishmael. deribbi yishmael amar . en haomer ba min hassuriyya. tamman tanninan. kol karbenot hayyachid vehatztzibbur bain min haaretz umichutza laaretz. min hechadash umin hayyashan. chutz min haomer ushete hallechem. sheen bain ella min hechadash umin haaretz. ribbi chuna veshem ribbi yirmeya. deribbi yishmael hi. deribbi yishmael amar. en haomer ba min hassuriyya. tamman tanninan. eser kedushshot hen. eretz yisrael mekuddeshet mikkol haaratzot. uma hi kedushshatah. shemmeviin mimmenna haomer vehabbikkurim ushete hallechem. ma sheen meviin ken mikkol haaratzot. ribbi chuna veshem ribbi yirmeya. deribbi yishmael hi. deribbi yishmael amar. en haomer ba min hassuriyya. tamman tanninan. rabbi yishmael omer. me charish reshut af katzir reshut. yatza ketzir haomer. shehu mitzva. have man tanna shomre sefichim bashsheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. ribbi yishmael. amar ribbi yose. divre hakkol hi. lo matzau vesuriyya meviin oto missefichin shebbeeretz yisrael. hahen omer mahu sheyyizzara lachen mittechilla. ribbi chiyay bar ada vea kome ribbi mana. lo nimtza chekometz al hashsheyeriym sheenan neechalin. amar leh. naase chachamishsha devarim shehen bain betumea veenan neechalin betumea.

Ketzad hu ose. notel maot min hashshulechani venoten lakkotzrin uleshomrin ad shello yakriv haomer. mevi maot mitterumat hallishka umechallan alav. vetavu chen. ribbi acha veshem ribbi ba. kol ma sheyyitten hen hen dameha mishshaa harishona. tanne. af befattache avanim ken. ketzad hu ose. notel maot mishshulechani venoten lachotzvin ulesattatin ad shello tinnaten al gabbe haddoymos. [achar kach] mevi maot mitterumat hallishka umechallan aleha. vetava hi chen. ribbi yose beribbi bun beshem shemuel. kol ma sheyyitten hen hen damav mishshaa harishona.

Mishna: para vesair hammishtalleach velashon shel zehorit bain mitterumat halishka. kevesh para vechevesh sair hammishtalleach velashon shebben karnav veammat hammayim vechomat hair umigdeloteha vechol tzarche hair bain mishsheyere hallishka. abba shaul omer kevesh para kohanim gedolim osin oto mishshel atzman: motar sheyere lishka me hayu osin bahen. lokchin bahen yenot shemanim uselatot vehassachar lahekdesh divre ribbi yishmael ribbi akiva omer in mishtakkerin beshshel hekdesh af lo mishshel aniyyim: motar hatteruma me hayu osin bah. rikkue zahav tzippuy levet kadshe hakkodashim. ribbi yishmael omer motar happerot kayaytz hammizbeach. motar teruma lichle sharet. ribbi akiva omer motar teruma kayaytz hammizbeach. motar nesachim lichle sharet. ribbi chananya segan hakkohanim omer motar nesachim kayaytz hammizbeach motar teruma lichle sharet. ze vaze lo hayu modin bapperot:

Halacha: para vesair 56. ribbi shemuel bar nachman beshem ribbi yonatan. shelosha leshonot hen. shelsair besela. shelmetzora beshekel. shelpara bishte selaim. ribbi choniyay divrat chavvran ribbi ba bar zavda beshem ribbi shimon ben chalfuta. shelpara bishte selaim umechetza. veit demafkin lishna . baasara (zin) [zuz] .

Rav yehuda veshem shemuel. talmide chachamim hamelammedin et hakkohanim hilchot shechita hilchot kabbala hilchot zerika notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. ribbi yitzchak bar redifa veshem immi. mevakkere mume kodashim notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. ribbi acha ribbi tanchum bar chiyay veshem ribbi simlay. maggihe sefer heazara notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. giddul bar binyamin besem assi. shene dayayne gezelot notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. shemuel amar. nashim haorgot bapperachot notlot secharan mitterumat hallishka. rav chuna amar. mitterumat bedek habbayit. ma ufelig. shemuel avad lah kekarban. rav chuna avad lah kebinyayn. amar ribbi chizkiyya. tanna ribbi yehuda gerogrot. hakketoret vechol karbenot hatztzibbur bain mitterumat hallishka. mizbach hazzahav vechol kele sharet bain mimmotare nesachim. mizbach haola vehahechol vehaazarot bein mishsheyyere lishka. chutz laazarot bain millishkat bedek habbayit. veha tanne. avne hammizbeach hahechol vehaazarot moalin bahen. vechi yesh meila bishyerim. ella cheribbi meir. deribbi meir amar. moalin bishyeriyim. amar ribbi chinna. kelum amar ribbi meir ella vetoch shenato. vehacha chutz lishnato anan kayaymin.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya. tanna ribbi yehuda gerogrot. hashshulchan vehammenora vehammizbechot vehapperachot meakkevin et hakkarban. divre ribbi meir. vachachamim om‌rin en lach meakkev et hakkarban ella hakkeyyor vehakkan bilvad. velo amar ken. ribbi elazar veribbi yose ben chanina terehon a‍merin. kol hen dichtiv nochach meakkev. tzela eno meakkev. veamar ribbi shemuel bar nachman beshem ribbi yonatan. vaafilu tzela meakkev. veamar ribbi ila veshem shemuel bar nachman. vaafilu sima meakkevet. amar ribbi chananya. kan baavodot shebbifnim vechan baavodot shebbachutz.

Amar ribbi chanina. shachatzit gedola ha‍yeta bivne chohanim gedolim. sheyyoter mishshishshim kikkere zahav [hayu motziin bah.] haya chivshah shelpara omed velo haya echad mehen motzi parato vechivsho shelchavero ella sotro uvone oto mishello. hativ ribbi ulla kome ribbi mana. veha tanne. shimon hatztzaddik shete farot asa. lo vechevesh shehotzi et zo hotzi et zo. it lach memar. shimon hatztzaddik shichetz haya. mayy chedon. al shem maala hi vefara silsul hu vefara. tanne. zizin uchetalin hayu yotzin mikkan umikkan kede shello yatzitzu hakkohanim veyittammu.

Ella im ratza yehe hahefsed shello. vehassachar lehekdesh muttar. kehada bar zemina it fekid gabbeh medal deyatmin. ata usheal leribbi mana. amar leh. in beit di hefsed didach veagra ditteravechon share. ribbi chiyay bar ada itfekid gabbeh medal deyatmin vaavad ken.

Kullah deribbi yishmael [hi]. ribbi chiyay bar yosef patar matnita. motar perot sachar lehekdesh. motar nesachim zo sea reviit. ribbi yochanan patar matnita. motar perot zo sea revioyt. motar nesachim leverutzim. velet leh leribbi chiyay bar yosef leverutzim. amar ribbi chizkiyya. ma dinfal lesa reviit nefal leverutzim. al dateh deribbi chiyay bar yosef nicha. en mistakkerin mishshelhekdesh af lo mishshelaniyyim. lefichach ze vaze lo hayu modin bapperot. al datih deribbi yochanan kashya. tanninan a‍medu mishshalosh yesappek mearba. vetanninan. veze vaze lo hayu modin bapperot lo hayu modin vapperot bekayitz lammizbeach. aval modin hayu vichle sharet. ad kedon berutze tzibbur. vaafilu verutze yachid. velo nimtzeu chele sharet bain mishshel yachid. kehada detanne. ishsha sheasat kuttonet livnah tzericha limsor letzibbur. ad kedon berutze lach. vaafilu verutze yavesh. kahi detanninan tamman. hannesachim shekkadshu vakkeli venimtza hazzevach pasul. im yesh sham zevach acher yikrevu immo. veim lav yippaslu velina.

Mishna: motar hakketoret me hayu osin bah mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin umechallelin otah al maot haummanin venotnin otah laummanin bishcharan vechozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha. veim ba chadash bizmanno lokchin otah mitteruma chadasha veim lav min hayyeshana:

Halacha: velo nimtza hahkaddesh mitachallel al hahekdesh. ketzad hu ose. amar ribbi shimon bar karsana. mevi maot umechallan al habbinyayn umevi ketoret umechallan alehen venotnin otan laumanin bischaran. otan hammaot ma yease vahen. ribbi omer. omer ani. yinatnu levet garmu ulevet avtinas shehayu vekiin befittum hakketoret uvemaase lechem happanim. amar ribbi shemuel bar rav. vehen sheyyehu chayayvin lahen maot mishshaa rishona. ribbi chiyay bar ba vae. lo hayu chayayvin lahen maot mishshaa harishona. ata ribbi ba veshem ribbi chiyay veshem ribbi yochnan. mekayyeytzin bahen et hammizbeach . ribbi ba bar kohen bea kome ribbi yose. michlefa shittateh deribbi chiyay bar ba. tamman tzericha leh vehacha feshita leh. hen ditzricha leh. bichle saret. hen difshita leh. bekayaytz lammizbeach.

Deitpallegon. fittemah vachulin. ribbi yose beribbi chanina amar. pesula. ribbi yehoshua ben levy amar. keshera. ma taama deribbi yose beribbi chanina. kodesh hi. shettehe havayaytah bakodesh. ma taama deribbi yehoshua ben levi. kodesh hi. shettehe vaa mitterumat hallishka. amar ribbi yose beribbi bun. atya deribbi yose ben chanina chishmuel uderibbi yehoshua ben levi cheribbi yochanan. detanninan. hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim reuyin lechol karbenot tzibbur. ribbi yochanan amar. ketoret. amar ribbi hoshaya. tiftar beomman mishshelbet evtinas shehaya notel bischaro ketoret. uderibbi yose beyyribbi chanina chishmuel. deamar rav huna veshem semuel. machteshet asu otah kichli sharet lekaddesh. amar ribbi yose beribbi bun. a‍merah rav chuna kome ribbi yose. davar shekkadash becheli sharet nifde. amar leh. velo dishmuel hi. dishmuel amar. kal hu vemotar. deitpallegon. hotiru temimim. shemuel amar. nifdim chitmimim. veribbi yochanan amar. nifdin chifsule hammukedashin. hotiru seirim. al dateh dishmuel. im ola nifdit lo kol shekken chattat. al dateh diribbi yochanan. amar ribbi zeura. yiru. amar ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak. mekayytzin bahen et hammizbeach. vekashya. yesh chattat kereva ola. amar ribbi yose. shanyay hi. sheen karbenot tzibbur nikbain alla vishchita. amar ribbi chananya. tenayy vet din hu al hammotarot sheyyakrevu olot.

Mishna: hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim reuyin lekarbenot hatztzibbur yinnatnu laummanin bischaran divre rabbi akiva. amar lo ben azay enah hi hammidda ella mafrishin mehen sechar haummanin umechallelin otan al maot haummanin venotnin otan laummanin bischaran vechozrin velokchin otan mitteruma chadasha: hammakdish nechasav veha‍yeta bahen behema reuya al gabbe hammizbeach zecharim unekevot. ribbi eliezer omer zecharim yimma‍cheru litzriche olot unekevot yimma‍cheru litzriche zivche shelamim udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit. ribbi yehoshua omer. zecharim atzman yikkarvu olot unekevot yimmachru litzriche zivche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot. ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit. amar ribbi akiva roe ani et divre ribbi eliezer middivre ribbi yehoshua sheribbi eliezer hishva et middotav veribbi yehoshua chalak. amar rabbi pappayas shamati et divre shenehen hammakdish beferush kedivre ribbi eliezer vehammakdish setam kedivre ribbi yehoshua: hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim reuyin legabbe mizbeach yenot ushemanim veofot. ribbi lazar omer yimmachru litzriche oto hammin veyavi bidmehen olot ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit:

Halacha: hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim reuyin lechol karbenot tzibbur. ribbi yochanan amar. ketoret. amar rav hoshaya. tiftar beomman mishshelbet evtinas shehaya notel bischaro ketoret. ma taameh daven azzay. shaen hahekdesh mitchallel al hammelacha elle al hammaot.

Tamman tanninan. yesh bekadshe vedek habbayit shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit. hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol umoalin begiddulehen veen bahen hanayay lakkohanim. amar ribbi chananya. deribbi liezer hi. detanninan. hammakdish nechasav veha‍yeta bahen behema reuya al gabbe hammizbeach zecharim unekevot. ribbi liezer omer. zecharim yimma‍cheru litzriche olot unekevot yimma‍cheru litzriche zivche shelamim udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit. amar ribbi yochanan. taameh deribbi liezer. veish ki‍10 yakdish et beto kodesh la‍Adonai. ma anan kayaymin. im bevet dira. kevar katuv im hammakdish yigal et betavo. ella chen anan kayaymin. bemakdish nechasav. mikkan shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit.

Ribbi zeura rav chuna veshem rav. peligin bammakdish nechasav. aval bammakdish edro kol amma modey shehu lammizbeach. ribbi ba rav chuna veshem rav. ma feligin. bammakdish edro. aval bammakdish nechasav kol amma modey shehu levedek habbayit. al dateh deribbi zeura nicha. vekashya al deribbi ba. behema lo lammizbeach hi. behema lammizbeach hi. velamma satam haish hazze. shehu chaomer. lo yehu ella levedek habbayit. ribbi yochanan amar. lo shanyay. hi hammakdish nechasav hi hammakdish edro. hi hammachaloket.

Rav chuna veshem rav ribbi abbahu veshem ribbi yochanan. kadshe vedek habbayit sheppodin temimin yatzu lechulin. matnita amra chen. uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonam. ribbi chizkiyya veshem rav chisda. tiftar sheppodin temimin vehumemu. ribbi yose veshem rav chisda. matnita amra chen. uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan. ribbi chizkiyya veshem ribbi yose. kadshe vedek habbayit sheppadyayn temimim yatzu lechulin. in temar. lo yatzu lechulin. heach kadshe hammizbeach chalin al kadshe vedek habbayit.

Baale mumin kedushat hammizbeach chala alehen. leyyd milla. laggiza velaavoda. hifrish nekeva leolato ulepischo uleashamo ose temura. ribbi shimon omer. leolato ose temura. lefischo uleashamo eno ose temura. ribbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum ribbi shimon. leolato. ulepischo uleashamo eno ose temura. amar ribbi yochanan. taameh deribbi shimon. shekken matzanu nekeva vaof cheshera lavo ola. [v]amar ribbi yochanan. taameh deribbi shimon. im min bemino hu chaluk alav lo chol shekken min besheeno mino. e zehu min bemino shehu chaluk alav. kehada detanne. asham ben shana hevi ben shetayim yatza. ben shetayim vehevi ben shalosh lo yatza. amar ribbi yochanan. ribbi shimon veribbi yehoshua shenehen amru davar echad. kema deribbi yehoshua amar. nekeva leola lo kadsha ella hekdesh damim. ken ribbi shimon amar. nekeva leola lo kadsha ella hekdesh damim. in temar. kadsha hekdesh guf yiru. amar ribbi. ani roe et divre ribbi shimon befesach shemma hekdesh pesach ba shelamim. velo ere et divre ribbi shimon baasham shemma hekdesh asham ba ola. amar ribbi abbin. im hekdesh pesach ba shelamim gufo karev shelamim. im hekdesh asham ba ola en gufo karev ola. may chedon. hahen amar. hekdesh damim kadash. vehahen amar. hekdesh guf kadash.

Ribbi zeura veshem ribbi shimon ben lakish. taameh deribbi yehoshua. dabber el aharon veel banav veel kol bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish mibbet yisrael 55. asher yakriv layy leola. hakkol karev leola. lirtz‍vonchem tamim zachar. menayin afilu nekevot. talmud lomar babbakar lerabbot et hannekevot. ribbi yitzchak beribbi elazar. katuv zachar. veat amarta babbakar lerabbot et hannekevot. vedichvatah katav tamim. veat amarta babbakar lerabbot baale mumen.
Ma venehun. rav amar. shivta decharchada venehon.

Ribbi abbahu veshem ribbi shimon ben lakish. taameh deribbi lazar. dabber el aharon veel banav vegomer. asher yakriv layy leola. hakkol karev ola. lirtz‍vonchem tamim zachar. yachol afilu ofot. talamud lomar babbakar. lo ofot. ribbi yirmeya veribbi bun bar chiyay havon yatvin veamrin. tamman amar ribbi yochanan. taameh deribbi shimon. shekken nekeva shebbaof cheshera lavo ola. vehacha hu amar hachen. amar ribbi yose. kiyaymtiha kahi deamar ribbi shemuel beshem ribbi zeura. kol sheenah yechola likkarev lo hi velo dameha lo kadsha ella hekdesh damim. veamarta yeut. lehakerivo en at yachol. dichtiv babbakar. lo ufot. lifdoto en at yachol. sheen laof pidyon. lefum ken tzarach memar. lo kadsha ella kedushat damim.

Chaverayay veshem ribbi yochanan. ribbi ayyvo bar naggari amar kome ribbi ila veshem ribbi yochanan. taama dehen tannayay. veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban layy. ma talmud lomar temea. ella afilu temea veoto hashshem. vekashya. beda chetiv veheemid veheerich. ribbi zeura veshem ribbi elazar. lo amar chen ella veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban layy. kol sheenah reuya likkarev lo chan velo vemakom acher enah osa temura. yatzat nekeva shebbaof sheaf al pi sheenah reuya likkarev kan reuya likkarev bemakom acher. ribbi bun veribbi bun beon kome ribbi zeura. hare harova vehannirba hare enan reuyin likkarev lo chan velo vemakom acher vahare hen osin temura. amar lon. af ani lo amarti ella temea mammash. vekashya. beda chetiv veheemid veheerich.

Mishna: achat lishloshim yom meshaarin et hallishka. kol hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba amdu mishshalosh yesappek mearba. mishshalosh veamdu mearba yesappek mearba sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona. im hitlia solet hitlia lo veim hechmitz yayin hechmitz lo. eno mekabbel et meotav ad sheyyehe hammizbeach meratztze:
Halacha: tanne veshem ribbi shimon. miyyad hayu mekabbelin et maotav. vehakkohanim zerizin hen.

Mishna: ellu hen hamemunnin shehayu bammikdash. yochanan ben pinchas al hachotamot. achiyay al hannesachim. matya ben shemuel al happeyaysot. petachya al hakkinnim petachya ze mardechay. velamma nikra shemo petachya shehaya poteach bidvarim vedorshan veyodea beshivim lashon. ben achiyay al chole meayim. nechuneyay chofer shichin. gevine charoz. ben gever al neilat shearim. ben bevay memunne al happakia .ben arza al hatztziltzal. hugedas ben levi al hashshir. bet garmu al maase lechem happanim. bet avtinas al maase hakketoret. elazar al hparochot ufinchas hammalbish.

Halacha: ellu hen hamemunnin shehayu bammikdash 56. ribbi chizkiyya amar. ribbi simon verabbanin. chad amar. keshere dor vador ba limnot [alehen]. vechorana amar. mi shehaya veoto haddor mana ma shebbedoro. man deamar. keshere kol dor vador ba limnot. al kullan hu omer. zecher tzaddik livracha. man deamar. mi shehaya veoto haddor mana ma shebbedoro. al kullan hu omer. veshem reshaim yirkav. veal mi neemar zecher tzaddik livracha. al ben katin vachaverav.

Amar ribbi yona. ketiv lachen achallek lo varabbim veet atzumim yechallek shalal. ze ribbi akiva shehitkin midrash halachot vehaggadot. veyesh omrim. ellu anshe cheneset haggedola. ma shehitkin ze chelalin uferatin.

Amar ribbi abbahu. ketiv mishpechot sofrim yovoshve yabetz. ma talmud lomar sofrim. ella sheasu et hattora sefurot sefurot. chamishsha lo yitromu. chamishsha devarim chayayvin bachalla chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen. sheloshim vashesh keretot battora. shelosha asar davar benivlat haof hattahor. arba avot nezikin. avot melachot arbaim chaser echat.
Amar ribbi acha. ketiv leezra hakkohen hassofer. ma talmud lomar sofer. ella cheshem shehaya sofer bedivre tora kach haya sofer bedivre chachamim.

Ribbi chaggayy veshem ribbi shemuel bar nachaman. harishonim charshu vezaru nikkeshu kissechu idderu katzru immiru dashu zaru barru tachanu hirkidu lashu kittifu veafu. veanu en lanu pe lochal. ribbi abba bar zemina veshem ribbi zeura. in havon kadmaey malachin anan bene enash. vein havon bene enash anan chamarin. amar ribbi mana. behahi shata amrin. afilu lachamarteh deribbi finchas ben yair la idminan.

Chamarteh deribbi finchas ben yair genavtah listae valleliyya. avdat temira gabbon telata yomin velo taama chelum. betar telata yomin imlachun machzartah. amrun. afkuna min hacha dela temut gabban. afkuna. azlat vekamat lah al tira damarah. sheriyayt menahaka. amar lon. patchun lahada alivta deit lah telata yomin dela taama chelum. patchun lah vealat lah. amar lon. yehavu lah techul. yehavun komah searin vela vaat michul. amrun leh. ribbi. la vaat michul. amar lon. metakkenin innun. amru leh. in. amar lon. vaarimitun demayin. amrun leh. lo chen alpan ribbi. hallokeach zera livhema kemach leorot shemen laor patur min haddemay. amar lon. ma naavid lahada alivta dehi machmera al garmah saggin. vaarimon demayin veachlat.

Petachya al hakkinnim. bo uree ma gadol hu chocho sheloto haish shehu poteach devarim vedorshan veyodea beshivim lashon. tanne. sanhedrin sheyyesh bah shenayim sheyyodin ledabber vechullan reuyin lishmoa hare zo reuya lesanhedrin. shelosha hare zo venonit. arbaa hare zo chachama. uveyavne hayu vah arbaa. ben azzay uven zoma ben chachinai veribbi elazar ben matya.

Amar rav chisda. paam achat yavsha eretz yisrael (vekaltu legaggot tzerifin.) [velo yadu mehechan lehavi. vahava tamman chad illem dahava yehiv chad yadeh al gaggot vechada yadeh al tzerifa. aytuneh kammeh diftacha. amar lahu. i atar demitkare gaggot tzerifin o tzerifin gaggot. azlin letamman veashkechon.] amar ribbi yose beribbi bun. paam achat nisdaf kol haolam kullo velo hayu yodin meechan lehavi. vahavav tamman chad illem vahava yehiv yadeh al eyyneh veyade͏y al sochra. ayytuneh gabbe fetachya. amar lon. it atar demitkare en socher o socher ayin. veazlon tamman veashkechon.

Shalosh nashim heviu kinnehen. achat omeret. leenati. veachat omeret leyammati. veachat omeret. lezivati. zo sheamra. leenati. savrin memar. shofaat chemaayayn. amar lon. beeyynah sechanat. zo sheamra. leyammati. savrin memar. shofaat kayyam. amar lon. beyammah sechanat. zo sheamra. lezivati. savrin memar. zava mammash. amar lon. zeev ba littol et benah.

Ben achiyay al chole meayim. al yede shehayu hakkohanim mehallechin yechefim al haritzpa vehayu ochlin basar veshotin mayim hayu vain lide chole meayim. vahava yeda ahey den chamar tav limayay. vehey den chamar semas limayay.

Nechuneyay chofer shichin. shehaya chofer shichin umearot. vahava yeda hey den kef mekorer maya vehey den kef it beh sharberuve vead matte hen sharberuviteh matayay. amar ribbi acha. umet [beno] vatztzama. amar ribbi chanina. man deamar derachamana vavtran yitvavtrun bene maoy. ella maarich rucheh vegave dideh. amar ribbi acha ketiv usevivav nisara meod. medakdek immahen kechut hasseara. amar ribbi yose. lo mittaam hazze. ella min ma dichtiv venora [hu] al kol sevivav. morao al hakkerovim yoter min harchokim.

Ribbi chaggayy veshem ribbi shemuel bar nachman. maase vechasid echad shehaya chofer borot shechin umearot laovrim velashshavim. paam achat hayta vitto overet lehinnase ushetafah nahar. vahavon kol amma allin legabbeh beayayn menachamteh vela kibbel aloy mitnachama. aal ribbi finchas ben yair legabbeh bae menachamteh vela kibbel aloy mitnachama. amar lon. den hinno chasidechon. amrin leh. ribbi. kach vechach haya ose vechach vechach ira. amar. efshar shehaya mechabbed et boro vammayim vehu mekappecho vammayim. miyyad nafla havara vair. baat bitto sheloto haish. it deamrin. beshucheta itariyayt. veit deamrin. malach yarad kidmut ribbi finchas ben yair vehitztzilah.

Gevine charoz. shehaya machriz bevet hammikdash. me haya omer. hakkohanim laavoda vehalleviyyim leduchan veyisrael lemaamad. agrippas hammelech shama kolo ad shemone farsaot venatan lo mattanot harebe.
Ben gever al neilat shearim. tirgem rav kome devet ribbi shila. kara gavra. achriz karoza. amrun leh. kara tarnugela. amar lon. vehatanninan ben gever. it lach memar bar tarnugela.

Ben bevay al happakia. shehaya mezaveg et happetilot. ribbi yose aal lechufera. bea mamniyay alehon parnasin vela kibbelun minneh. aal veamar komehon. ben bevay al happakia. uma im ze shennitmanne al happetilot zacha lehimmanot im gedole haddor. attem sheattem mitmannin al chayye nefashot lo chol shekken.
Ben arza al hatztziltzal. kahi detanninan tamman. henif hassegan bassudarin vehikkish ben arza batztziltzal.

Hugedas ben livy al hashshir. amar ribbi acha. neima yetera haya yodea. veamru alav al hugedas ben levi shehaya manim et kolo vazzemer. ucheshehaya noetz godlo letoch piv haya motzi chamma mine zemer vhayu echav hakkohanim nizkarin lo vat rosh.
