Bet garmu al maase lechem happanim bet garmu hayu vekiin bemaashe lechem happanim uveriddiyayto velo ratzu lelammed. shalchu veheviu umanim mealekkesanderia vehayu vekiin bemaashe lechem happanim. uveriddiyayto lo hayu vekiin. bet garmu hayu massikin mibbifnim verodin mibbachutz. velo hayta mitappeshet. veellu hav massikin mibbifnim verodin mibbifnim. vehayta mitappeshet. kevan sheyyadu chachamim baddavar hazze amru. kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu lichvodo bara. shenneemar kol paal Adonai lammaanehu. shalchu acharehem velo ratzu lavo ad shekkaflu lahen secharan. shenem asar mena hayu notlin venatnu lahen esrim vearba. ribbi yehuda omer. esrim vearba hayu notlin venatnu lahen arbaim ushemone. amru lahen. mippene ma en attem rotzin lelammed. amru lahen. mesoret hi veyadenu meavotenu shehabbayit hazze atid licharev. shello yilmedu acherim veyihyu osin ken lifne avoda zara shellahen. bidvarim hallalu mazkirin otan lishvach. shello yatza beyad benehem pat nekiyay meolam. shello yehu omrim. mimmaase lechem happanim hen ochlin.

Bet avtinas al maase hakketoret. shelbet avtinas hayu vekiin vefittum hakketoret uvemaale heashan velo ratzu lelammed. shalchu veheviu umanim mealekkesanderia vehayu vekiin vefittum hakketoret. uvemaale ashan lo hayu vekiin. shelbet avtinas hayta metammeret veola upposa veyoredet. veshelelu hayta fosa miyyad. kevan sheyyadu chachamim baddavar amru. kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu lichvodo bara. shenneemar kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ vegomer. shalchu acharehem velo ratzu lavo ad shekkaflu lahen secharan. shenem asar mena hayu notlin venatnu lahen esrim vearbaa. ribbi yehuda omer. esrim vearbaa hayu notlin venatnu lahen arbaim ushemone. amru lahen. mippene ma en attem rotzin lelammed. amru lahen. mesoret beyadenu meavotenu shehabbayit hazze atid licharev. shello yilmedu acherim veyihyu osin ken bifne avoda zara shellahen. bidvarim hallalu mazkirin otan lishvach. shello yatzat ishsha mishshelleechad mehen mevusemet meolam. velo od ella cheshehaya echad mehen nose ishsha mimmakom acher haya fosek immah al menat shello titbassem. [shello yehu omrim. mimmaase fittum hakketoret hen mitbassemot. lekayem ma shenneamar. vihyitem nekiyyim mey umiyyisrael.]

Amar ribbi yose. matzati tinnok echad mishshellebet avtinas. amarti lo. beni. mee ze mishpacha at. amar li. mimmishpachat pelonit. amarti lo. beni. avotech lefi shennitkavvnu lerabbot kevodan ulemaet kevod shamayim lefichach kevodam nitmaet uchevod shamayim nitrabba. amar ribbi akiva. sach li shimon ben lugo. melakket hayiti asavim ani vetinnok echad mishshellebet avtinas. veraiti oto shebbacha veraiti oto shessachak. amarti lo. beni. lamma vachita. amar li. al kevod bet abba shennitmaet. velamma sachakta. amar li. al hakkavod hametukkan latztzaddikim leatid levo. [uma raita.] hare maale ashan lenegdi. nometi lo. beni. hareehu li. amar li. ribbi. mesoret beyadi meavotayy shello lehareoto leviryay. amar ribbi yochanan ben nuri. paga bi zaken [echad] mishshelbet avtinas [umegillat sammanim veyado.] amar li. ribbi. lesheavar hayu vet abba tzenuin vehayu mosrin et hamegilla hazzot ellu laellu. veachshav sheenan neemanin helach et hamegilla vhizzaher bah. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti haddevarim lifne ribbi akiva zalgu enav demaot veamar. meatta en anu tzerichin lehazekiran lignay.

Elazar al happarochot. shehaya memunne al orge ferachot. pinchas hammalbish. shehaya malbish bigde chehuna gedola. maase vechohen echad shehilbish leisteratyot echad venatan lo shemona zehuvin. veit deamrin. tere asar yehiv leh.

Mishna: en pochatin mishshiva markolin ushelosha gizbarin. veen osin serara al hatztzibbur bemamon pachut mishshenayim. chutz mibben achiyya sheal chole meayim veelazar sheal happarochot sheotan kibbelu hatztzibbur alehen:

Halacha: en pochatin mishshelosha gizbarin umishshiva markolin. tanne. mishshene katolikin. hada hi dichtiv vichiel veoziyyahv umachat gizberin. vaasael virimot veyozavad veeliel usemachyahu umachat uvenayahu markolin. pekidim miyyad kavnanyahu veshimi achiv katoyolikin. bemifkad yechizkiyyahu hammelech vaazaryahu negid bet haelohim. hammelech vechohen gadol.

Keshehu chotem haggizbar chotem venotno laamarkol. markol chotem venotno lekatoylikos. katoylikon chotem venotno lechohen gadol. kohen gadol chotem venotno lammelech. ucheshehu mattir hammelech roe chotamo umattir. kohen gadol roe chotamo umattir. katoylikays roe chotamo umattir. markol roe chotamo umattir. gizbar roe chotamo umattir.
En osin serara al hatztzibbur bemamon pachut mishshenayim. ribbi nachman veshem ribbi mana. al shem vehem yikchu et hazzahav veet hattechelet veet haargaman.

Amar ribbi chama beribbi chanina. mippesolet halluchot heeshir moshe. hada hu dichtiv pesal lecha shene luchot avanim. pesal lecha shettehe happesolet shellacha. amar ribbi chanin. machtzev shelavanim tovot umargaliot bara lo hakkadoshsh baruch hu mittoch ohalo umimmennu heeshir moshe.

Ketiv vehibbitu achare moshe ad boo haohela. teren amorin. chad amar lignay. vechad amar lishvach. man daamar lignay. chamun shukkin chamun karin chamun kufedan. achil min dihudae veshati min dihudae. kol middeleh min dihudae. uman daamar lishvach. mechme tzaddikayya umazki [toviyya dizchat lemechme yateh.]

Mishna: arbaa chotamot hayu bammikdash vechatuv alehen egel zachar gedi vechote. ben azzay omer chamishsha hayu vaaramit katuv alehen egel dachar gedi chote dal vechote ashir. egel meshammesh im niske bakar gedolim uketannim zecharim unekevot. gedi meshammesh im niske tzon gedolim uketannim zecharim unekevot chutz mishshel elim. ayil meshammesh im niske elim bilvad. chote meshammesh im niske shalosh behemot shel metzora: mi shehu mevakkesh nesachim holech lo etzel yochanan shehu memunne al hachotamot noten lo maot umekabbel mimmennu chotam. ba lo etzel achiyay shehu memunne al hannesachim venoten lo chotam umekabbel mimmennu nesachim. velaerev bain ze etzel ze vaachiyay motzi et hachotamot umekabbel kenegdan maot. im pachatu fachato lo vishallem yochanan mibbeto. veim hotiru hotiru lahekdesh sheyyad hekdesh laelyona: mi sheavad chotamo mamtinin lo ad haerev. im matzu lo kede chotamo notnin lo. veim lav lo hayu notnin lo. veshem hayyom katuv alehen mippene harammain:

Halacha: ucheven azzay chote [dal] lamma. haya mevi lugo immo. beram kerabbanin mevi gedi. nische rachel ma. min ma detanninan. gedi meshammesh niske tzon gedolim uketannim zecharim unekevot. hada amra. niske rachel cheniske gedi. ketiv kacha yease lashshor haechad o laayil haechad o lasse vakkevasim o vaizzim. maggid shello chillek ben niske egel leniske shor. shehaya vedin. ben hatztzon taun nesachim [u]ven habbakar taun nesachim. im matzanu shechillek ben niske keves leniske ayil lechach nachalok ben niske egel leniske shor. talmud lomar kacha yease lashshor haechad. maggid shello chillek ben niske egel leniske shor. o laayil lamma neemar. shehaya vedin. im matzanu shechillek ben niske ben shana leniske ben shetayim lechach nachalok ben niske shetayim leniske shalosh. talmud lomar o laayil haechad. o lasse bakkesavim. lamma neemar. shehaya vedin. im matzanu shechillek ben niske cheves leniske ayil lechach nachalok ben niske chisba leniske rachel. talmud lomar o lasse bakkesavim. o vaizzim. lamma neemar. shehaya vedin. im matzanu shechillek ben niske cheves leniske ayil lechach nachalok ben niske gedi leniske tayish. talmud lomar o vaizzim. hikkish katan shebbaizzim legadol shebbatteyayshim. ma ze bishloshet luggin af ze bishloshet luggin.

Hagga atzmach shezzivevg oto hayyom. shem mishmar haya chatuv alav. hagga atzmach shezzivevg oto hammishmar. shem hayyom shem shabbat shem chodesh haya chatuv alehen. afilu lezavveg eno matzuy lezavveg.

Mishna: shete leshachot hayu bammikdash achat lishkat chashaim veachat lishkat hakkelim. lishkat chashaim yiree chet notnim letochah bachashay vaaniyyim bene tovim mitparnesin mittochah bachashay. lishkat hakkelim kol mi shehu mitnaddev keli zorko letochah. veachat lishloshim yom haggizbarin potchin otah. keli shemmotzin bo tzorech levedek habbayit mannichin oto. vehashshear nimkarin udemihen noflin lelishkat bedek habbayit:

Halacha: ribbi yaakov bar idi veribbi yitzchak bar nachman havon parnasin vahavon yehavin leribbi chama avoy deribbi hoshaya denar vehu yehiv leh lechoranin. ribbi zecharya chatneh deribbi livy hayu hakkol melizin alav. amrin dela tzarich vehu nesav. min didmach badkon veashkechon dahava maflig leh lechoranin.

Ribbi chinna bar pappa hava maflig mitzva vallayliya. chad zeman pega beh rabbehon deruchayay. amar leh. lo chen alpan ribbi. lo tassig gevul reacha. amar leh. velo chen ketiv mattan basseter yichpe af. vahava mistafe minneh vaarak min komoy.

Amar ribbi yona. ashre noten laddal en katuv kan ella ashre maskil el dal. ze shehu mistakkel bammitzva heach laasotah. ketzad haya ribbi yona ose. keshehaya roe ven tovim sheyyarad minnechasav haya omer lo. beni. bishvil sheshshamati shennafla lach yerusha mimmakom acher. tol veat porea. min dahava nesiv hava amar leh. mattana.
Amar ribbi chiyay bar ada. it hava sabbin beyomenan. man dahava yehiv lon mibben resh shatta letzoma rabba havun nasvin. min batar ken la havun nasvin. amrin deshutan gabban.

Nechemya ish shichin paga bo yerusholmi echad. amar leh. zeche immi chada tarnugela. amar leh. he lach timite kuppad. uzevan kuppad veachal vamit. vahava tzevavch veamar. bou vesifdu laharugo shelnechemya.

Nachum ish gimzo haya molich doron levet chamiv. paga bo mukke shechin echad. amar lo. zeche immi mimma deit gabbach. amar leh. michzar. chazar veashkecheh mit. vahava amar lekibbeleh. eyneh dachaminach vela yehavon lach yistamyayn. yadayay dela fashtan mitten lach yitkattean. raglayay dela rahatan lemitten lach yetabberan. umatteteh ken. selik legabbeh ribbi akiva. amar leh. i li sheani roe otach ken. amar leh. i li sheen ani roe otach ken. amar leh. ma at mekalleni. amar leh. uma at mevaet bayyisurin.

Ribbi hoshaya rabba hava rabbeh divreh chad desaggi nehura vahava yelif achil immeh bechol yom. chad zeman hava leh orchin vela meta mechol immeh. berumesha selik legabbeh. amar leh. lo yichos mari alayy. begin dahava li orchin yoma den. [deamrit dela livzuy bikara demari yoma den begin lo achlit im mari yoma den.] amar leh. atta piyaysta leman demitchame vela chami. den dachami vela mitchame yekabbel piyyusach. amar leh. hada mena lach. amar leh. meribbi eliezer ben yaakov. [d]ribbi eliezer ben yaakov aal chad desaggi nehura lekarteh. yetav leh ribbi liezer ben yaakov lera minneh. deyemrun deilule dehu bar nashsha rabba la yetav leh ribbi liezer ben yaakov lera minneh. avdun leh parnasa deikar. amar lon. mahu hachen. amron leh. ribbi eliezer ben yaakov yetiv lera minnach. utzeloy aloy hada tzeluta. atta gamalta chesed leman demitchame vela chami. den dachami vela mitchame yigmol yatach chesed.

Deloma. ribbi chama bar chanina vribbi hoshaya havun metayylin beillen kenishta delod. amar ribbi chama bar chanina leribbi hoshaya. kamma mamon shikkeu avotayy chan. amar leh. kamma nefashot shikkeu avotecha chan. la havav it bene nash deyilun beurayta.
Ribbi avun avad illen tarayay desidra rabba. ata ribbi mana legabbeh. amar leh. chami ma avdit. amar leh. vayyishkach yisrael et osehu vayyiven hechalot. la hava bene nash deyilun beorayta.

Tanne. kadshe hammizbeach motziin et harauy lahen mikkadshe vedek habbayit. en kadshe vedek habbayit motziin et harauy lahen mikkadshe hammizbeach. veha tanninan keli shemmatzu bo tzorech levedek habbayit mannichin oto. vehashshear nimkarin udemihen noflin lelishkat bedek habbayit. amar ribbi chizkiyya. keni matnita. letzorech lishkat bedek habbayit.

Mishna: shelosha asar shofarot shelosha asar shulchanot shelosh esre hishtachavayot hayu bammikdash. shel bet rabban gamliel veshel bet rabbi chananya segan hakkohanim hayu mishtachavim bearba esre. vehechan hayta yetera keneged dir haetzim shekken masoret beyadan meavotehen sheshsham haaron ganuz: maase bechohen echad shehaya mitassek veraa haritzpa shehi meshunna mechaveroteha. ba veamar lachavero. lo hispik ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmato. veyadu veyichud sheshsham haaron ganuz:
Halacha: shelosha asar shofarot 56. tanne. hashshofarot hallalu akumot hayu. tzarot millemaalan urechavot milmattan mippene harammain.

Tanne veshem ribbi eliezer. haaron gala immahen levavel. ma taam. lo yivavter davar amar Adonai. en davar ella shehaddibberot letocho. vechen hu omer. velitshuvat hashshana shalach hammelech nevuchadnetztzar vayviehu vavela im kele chemdat bet Adonai. e zehu chemdat bet Adonai. ze haaron. ribbi shimon ben lakish amar. bimkomo haya haaron ganuz. hada hu dichtiv vayyaarichu habbaddim vayyerau rashe habbaddim el hakkodesh el pene haddevir velo yerau hachutza. ketiv vayye‍rau veat amar velo yerau. ella nirin velo nirin. boltin veyotzin kishne dadde haishsha.

Verabbanin amrin. belishkat dir haetzim haya haaron ganuz. maase vechohen echad baal mum shehaya omed umaftzia etzim belishkat dir haetzim veraa et haritzpa shehi meshunna mechaveroteha. ba veamar lachavero. bo uree et haritzpa hazzot shehi meshunna mechaveroteha. lo hispiku ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmeto. veyadu veyichud sheshsham haaron ganuz. tanne ribbi hoshaya. hikkish aleha vekurenas veyatzat esh userafato.

Tanne. ribbi yuda ben lakish amar. shene aronot hayu mehallechin im yisrael bammidbar. echad shehayta hattora netuna vetocho. veechad shehayu shivre halluchot netunin vetocho. ze shehayta hattora netuna vetocho haya munach beohel moed. hada hi dichtiv vaaron berit Adonai umoshe lo mashu mikkerev hammachane. ze shehayu shivre halluchot vetocho haya nichnas veyotze immahen ufeamim hu matre immahen. verabbanin amre. aron echad haya ufaam achat yatza vime eli venishba. kiryay mesayea lehon lerabbanin. oy lanu mi yatztzilenu miyyad haelohim haaddirim haelle. milla dela chamun min yomehon. kiryay mesayea leribbi yuda ben lakish. vayyomer shaul laachiyya haggisha aron haelohim. vahalo aron bekiryat yearim haya. ma avdun leh rabbanin. haggisha elay hatztzitz. kiryay mesayea leribbi yuda ben lakish. haaron veyisrael vihuda yoshvim bassukkot. vahalo aron betziyyon haya. ma avdun leh rabbanin. sechach shehu chekiruy. sheaddayin lo nivne vet habbechira.

Mishshennignaz haaron nignaz immo tzintzennet hamman utzelochit shemen hammishcha umaklo shelaharon uferachav ushekedav veargaz sheheshivu felishtim asham lelohe yisrael. mi genazo. yoshiyyahu genazo. kevan sheraa shekkatuv yolech Adonai otcha veet malkecha asher takim alecha el goy asher lo yadata atta vaavotecha. amad ugenazo. hada hu dichtiv vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechol yisrael hakkedoshim layy tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven david melech yisrael en lachem massa bakkatef. amar lahen. im gole hu immachem levavel od en attem machazirin oto limkomo. ella atta ivdu et Adonai elohechem veet ammo yisrael.

Pittum shemen hammishcha veatta kach lecha besamim rosh vegomer vekidda chamesh meot vegomer. shehen elef vachamesh meot manim. shemen zayit hin. shehen shenem asar log shebbo sholkin et haikkarin. divre ribbi meir. ribbi yehuda omer. sholkan haya vammayim venoten shemen al gabbehen. mishshehaya kolet et hareach haya maaviro kaderech shehappattamin osin. hada hu dichtiv shemen mishchat kodesh vegomer.

Tanne ribbi yuda beribbi ilay. shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe vammidbar maase nissim naasu vo mittechilla vead sof. shemmittechilla lo haya vo ella shenem asar log. shenneemar shemen zayit hin. im lasuch bo et (heetzim) [haikkarim] lo haya vo safak. al achat kamma vechamma shehaor bolea vehaetzim bolin vehayyora volaat. umimmennu nimoshchu hammishkan vechol kelav. hashshulchan vechol kelav. hammenora vechol keleha. umimmennu nimoshchu aharon chohen gadol uvanav kol shivat yeme hammilluim. mimmennu nimshechu kohanim gedolim umelachim. melech battechilla taun meshicha. melech ben melech eno taun meshicha. [may taama. kum mashchehu ki ze hu. ze taun meshicha veen beno taun meshicha.] aval kohen gadol ben kohen gadol afilu ad asara dorot teonin meshicha. vechollo kayaym leatid lavo. hada hu dichtiv shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem.

En moshchin melachim ella al gabbe hammaayayn. hada hu dichtiv vehirkavtem et shelomo veni al happirda asher li vehoradtem oto el gichon. umashach oto sham tzadok hakkohen venatan hannavi lemelech al yisrael. en moshchin (melachim) [melech ben melech] ella mippene hammachaloket. mippene ma nimshach shelomo. mippene machalokato shellaadoniyyahu. yoash mippene atalya. yehu mippene yoram. lo chen katuv kum meshachehu ki ze hu. ze taun meshicha veen malche yisrael teunin meshicha. ella yehoachaz mippene yehuyakim achiv shehaya gadol mimmennu shete shanim. velo yishiyyahu genazo. hada amra. beappersamon meshacho. en moshchin melachim ella min hakkeren. shaul veyehu nimshechu min happach. shehayta malchutan malchut overet. david ushelomo nimshechu min hakkeren. shehayta malchutan malchut kayemet. en moshchin kohanim melachim. amar ribbi yudan antonderayay. al shem lo yasur shevet mihuda. amar ribbi chiyay bar ada. lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto hu uvanav bekerev yisrael. ma chetiv batreh. lo yihye lakkohanim haleviyyim.

Amar ribbi yochanan. hu yochanan hu yehoachaz. veha chetiv habbechor yochanan. bechor lammalchut. amar ribbi yochanan. hu shallum hu tzidkiyyahu. vehachtiv hashshelishi tzidkiyyahu veharvii shallum. shelishi letoldot revii lammalchut. tzidkiyyahu shetztziddek alav middat haddin. shallum shebbeyamav shalma malchut bet david. la shallum hava shemeh vela tzidkiyyahu hava shemeh ella mattanya. hada hu dichtiv vayyamlech melech bavel et mattanya dodo tachtav vayyassev et shemo tzidkiyyahu.

Amar ribbi yochanan. baamma shel shishsha tefachim haya haaron asuy. man tanna. baamma shel shishsha tefachim. ribbi meir [hi. ditnan. ribbi meir omer. kol haammot hu chevinyaynot. ribbi yehuda omer. ammat habbinyayn shishsha. shel kelim chamishsha.] al dateh deribbi meir du amar. baamma shel shishsha tefachim haya haaron asuy. orko shelaron chammishsha asar tefach. dichtiv ammatayim vachetzi arko. amta ashita veamta ashita ufalgut amta telata. vearbaa lochut hayu bo. shenayim shelemim ushenayim shevurim. dichtiv asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron. halluchot hayu kol echad veechad arko shishsha tefachim verachbo (shelosha) [shishsha.] veten orchan shel luchot (lerochvo) [learko] shelaron nishtayer sham shelosha tefachim. (tenem leisttevav) [ten mehem chatzi tefach lechol kotel nishtayer shene tefachim lesefer tora.] rachbo shelaron tisha tefachim. dichtiv amma vachetzi rachbo. amta ashita ufalgut amta telata. vearbaa lochut hayu bo. shenayim shelemim ushenayim shevurim. dichtiv asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron. halluchot hayu kol achat veachat arkan shishsha tefachim verachban (shelosha) [shishsha.] ten arkan shelluchot lerochvo shelaron nishtayer sham shelosha tefachim chatzi tefach mikkan vachatzi tefach mikkan leshillut. umekom shemmannichin bo sefer tora tefachayim.

Ribbi shimon ben lakish amar. baamma shelchamishsha tefachim haya haaron asuy. man tanna. baamma shelchamishsha tefachim. ribbi yehuda. detanninan tamman. ribbi yehuda omer. ammat habbinyayn shishsha tefachim veshelkelim chamishsha. vehahen aron keli hu. al dateh deribbi yuda du amar. baamma shelchamishsha tefachim haya arko shelaron asuy. shenem asar tefach umechetza. dichtiv ammatayim vachetzi arko. amta chamishsha veamta chamishsha ufalgut amta terey ufelig. vearbaa lochut hayu vo. shenayim shelemim ushenayim shevurim. dichtiv asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron. vehalluchot hayu kol echad veechad arkan shishsha tefachim verachban shelosha. ten rachban shelluchot leorko shelaron venishtayer sham chatzi tefach. etzba lichtalim mikkan veetzba lichtalim mikkan. rachbo shelaron shiva tefachim umechetza. dichtiv amma vachetzi rachbo. amta chamishsha ufalgut amta terey ufelig. vearbaa lochut hayu vo. shenayim shelemim ushenayim shevurim. dichtiv asher shibbarta vesimtam baaron. halluchot hayu kol echad veechad arkan shishsha tefachim verachban shelosha. ten archan shelluchot lerachbo shelaron venishtayer sham tefach umechetza. etzba lichtalim mikkan veetzba lichtalim mikkan. chatzi tefach mikkan vachatzi tefach mikkan leshillut.

Ketzad asa vetzalel et haaron. ribbi chanina amar. shalosh tevot asao shetayim shelzahav veachat sheletz. natan (sheletz beshelzahav v)shelzahav besheletz [veshel etz beshelzahav]. vetzippahu. dichtiv vetzippita oto zahav tahor mibbayit umichutz. ma talmud lomar tetzappennu. lehavi sefato haelyona. ribbi shimon ben lakish amar. teva achat asao vetzippahu. dichtiv vetzippita oto zahav tahor mibbayit umichutz. ma talmud lomar tetzappennu. amar ribbi finchas lehavi ven neser leneser.

Ketzod hayu halluchot ketuvim. ribbi chananya ben gamliel omer. chamishsha al luach ze vachamishsha al luach ze. hada hu dichtiv vayyichtevem al shene luchot avanim. chamishsha al luach ze vachamishsha al luach ze. verabbanin amrin. asara al luach ze vaasara al luach ze. hada hu dichtiv vayyagged lachem et berito asher tzivva etchem laasot aseret haddevarim. asara al luach ze vaasara al luach ze. ribbi shimon ben yochay amar. esrim al luach ze veesrim al luach ze. dichtiv vayyichtevem al shene luchot avanim. esrim al luach ze veesrim al luach ze. ribbi simay amar. arbaim al luach ze vearbaim al luach ze. mizze umizze hem ketuvim. tetragona. chananya ben achi ribbi yehoshua omer. ben chol dibbur vedibbur dikdukeha veototeha sheltora. memullaim battarshish. keyamma rabba. ribbi shimon ben lakish kad hava matte haden kiryay hava amar. yafe limmedeni chananya ben achi ribbi yehoshua. ma hayyam hazze ben gal gadol legal [gadol] gallim ketannim kach ben kol dibber vedibber dikdukeha veototeha sheltora.

Amar ribbi tanchuma. itkashyayt kome ribbi finchas. atya cheribbi yuda vela atya cheribbi meir. ma taameh deribbi yuda. lakoach et sefer hattora hazzot vesamtem oto mitztzad aron berit Adonai vegomer. al dateh deribbi yuda du amar. echan haya sefer tora natun. kemin gelossokos asa lo mibbachutz vehaya sefer tora natun letocho. ma taameh deribbi meir. venatatta et hakkapporet al haaron milmala vegomer. al dateh deribbi meir du amar. en mukedam umeuchar battora. ella veel haaron titten et haedut asher etten elecha. veachar kach venatatta et hakkapporet al haaron milmala. ribbi finchas veshem ribbi shimon ben lakish. hattora shennatan lo hakkadosh baroch hu lemoshe netanah lo esh levana charuta veesh shechora. hi esh muvelelet veesh chatzuva meesh unetuna meesh. hada hu dichtiv mimino esh dat lamo.

Mishna: hechan hayu hahishtachaviyyot haellu. arba batztzafon vearba baddarom shalosh bammizrach ushetayim bammaarav keneged shelosha asar shearim shearim deromiyyim semuchin lammaarav shaar haelyon shaar haddelek shaar habbechorot shaar hammayim. velamma nikra shemo shaar hammayim shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim shel nissuch chammayim bechag. ribbi eliezer ben yaakov omer bo hammayim mefakkim atidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. leummatan batztzafon semuchin bammaarav shaar yechanya shaar hakkarban shaar hannashim shaar hashshir. velamma nikra shemo shaar yechanya shebbo yatza yechanya begaluto. shebbammizrach shaar nikanor ushene fishpeshin hayu lo echad bimino veechad bismolo. ushenayim bammaarav velo haya lahem shem:

Halacha: matnita deabba yose ven chanin. deabba yose ven chanin amar. keneged shelosha asar shearim. beram kerabbanin shiva shearim hayu vaazara. al daton derabbanin echan hayu hishtachaviyyot halalu. kahi detanninan tamman. shelosha asar feratzot hayu vo shepperatzum malche yavavn. chazru ugedarum vegazru kenegdan shelosh esre hishtachavayot.

Ketiv vehaya bayyom hahu yetzu mayim chayyim mirushalam vegomer. tanne. bet kodesh hakkadashim ad happarachot kekarne silayy uvilayy. min happarachot ad mizbach hazzahav kekarne chagavim. mimmizbach hazzahav vead haazarot kechut shel sheyti. min haazarot vead miftan habbayit kechut shel erev. mikkan vahelach kemippi happach. vehinne mayim mefakkim min hakkatef hayemanit. ketiv betzet haish kadim vekav beyado vayyamad elef baamma vayyaavireni vammayim me afsayim. ad karsule. vayyamad elef vayyaavireni vammayim mayim birkayim. ad birkayay. vayyamad elef vayyaavireni me matnayim. ad matnayay. mikkan vehelach vayyamad elef nachal asher lo uchal laavor. afilu libburnin gedola enah yechola laavor bo. ma taama vetzi addir lo yaavrennu. mippene ma ki gau hammayim me sachu. mahu me sachu. milleshot. amar ribbi chuna. beatrin tzevavchin leshayyta sechuna. uferas yadav bekirbo kaasher yefares hassoche lischot mahu lischot. amar ribbi yose beribbi bun. mayin demitmallelin bealma. ketiv bayyom hahu yihye makor niftach levet david uleyovoshve yerushalam lechattat ulenidda. ribbi shemuel bar nachman beshem ribbi yonatan. mibbet david vead yoshve yerushalam kesherim lenidda ulechattat. mikkan vehelach me taaruvot hem. kesherim lenidda ufesulim leme chattat. amar ribbi lazar. mibbet david vead yoshve yerushalam kesherim lenidda ulechattat. mikkan vehelach me kattefresot hen. pesulin lenidda ulechattat.

Ketiv vayyomer elay hammayim haelle yotzim el haggelila hakkadmona ze yam shelsamcho. veyardu el haarava ze yam sheltibberiyya. uvau hayyamma ze yam hammelach. el hayyamma hammutzaim ze hayyam haggadol. velamma nikra shemo motzaim. keneged shene feamim sheyyatza. [echad bedor enosh veechad bedor pelaga.] ribbi lazer beshem ribbi chanina. barishona yatz ad kalabberia uvashniyay yatza ad kefe berberiya. ribbi acha veshem ribbi chanina. barishona yatz ad kefe berberiya vashniyay yatza ad akko vead yafo. ad po tavo velo tosif. ad akko tavo velo tosif. ufo yashit bigon gallecha. ad yafo ashit geon gallecha. nicha yamma rabba yamma demilcha. bishvil lemitkan. yamma detibberiyya yamma desamcho. lerabbot degatam. lemina tihye degatam. lemine minim tihye degatam. tanne. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel. maase shehalachti letzayydan veheviu lefanayy yoter mishlosh meot mine dagim betamchuy echad.
Venirpou hammayim. betztzotav ugevaav velo yerafu lemelach nittanu. ketiv venirpou hammayim veat amarta. velo yerafu hammayim. makom hu sheshshemo velo yerafu.

Ketiv veal hannachal yaale al sefato mizze umizze kol etz maachol lo yibbol alehu velo yittom piryo lochodashav yevakker. tanne amar ribbi yehuda. lefi shebbaolam hazze tevua osa leshishsha chodashim veilan ose lishnem asar chodesh. aval leatid lavo hattevua osa lechodesh echad veilan ose lishne chodashim. ma taameh. lochodashav yevakker. amar ribbi yose. lefi shebbaolam hazze hattevua osa leshishsha chodashim vehailan ose lishnem asar chodesh. aval leatid lavo hattevua osa lachamishsha asar yom veilan ose lechodesh echad. shekken matzanu sheasat hattevua vime yoel lachamishsha asar yom vekarev mimmenna haomer. ma taameh. uvene tziyyon gilu vesimchu bayy elohechem ki natan lachem et hammore litzdaka vayyored lachem geshem yore umalkosh barishon. ma mekayem ribbi yose lochodashav yevakker. bechol chodesh vachodesh yehe mevakker. vealehu litrufa. ribbi yochanan amar. tarpeh metzatz aleh votaraf mezone. rav ushemuel. chad amar. lehattir pe shelmaalan. vechorana amar. lehattir pe shelmattan. ribbi chanina veribbi yehoshua ben levi. chad amar lehattir pe akarot. vechorana amar. lehattir pe illemim.

At motze. beshaa sheala nevuchadnetztzar lechan ba veyashav lo vedifne shelantivochiyya veyatzaa sanhedrin gedola likrato veamra lo. higgia zeman habbayit hazze licharev. amar lahen. oto shehimlachti oto alechem tenuhu li vaani holech li. bau veamru lihoyachin melech yehuda. nevuchadnetztzar bae lach. kevan sheshshama mehen kach natal maftechot shelvet hammikdash. ala legaggo shelhechol. amar lafanav. ribbono shelolam. lichsheavar hayinu neemanin lach vehayu maftechotecha mesurin lanu. achshav sheen anu neemanin hare maftechotecha mesurin lach. teren amorin. chad amar. zerakan veod lo yardu. vechorana amar. raa chemin yad notalletan miyyado. kevan sherau kol chore yehuda chen alu lerosh gaggotehen venaflu vametu. hada hu dichtiv massa ge chizzayon ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot. teshuot melea ir homiyya vegomer.

Mishna: shelosha asar shulechanot hayu bammikdash shemone shel shayish bevet hammitbechayim shealehen medichin et hakkeravayim. ushenayim bemaarav hakkevesh echad shel shayish veechad shel kesef al shel shayish notnin et haevarin veal shel kesef kele sharet. ushenayim baulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit echad shel shayish veechad shel zahav. al shel shayish notnim lechem happanim bichnisato veal shel zahav bitziato shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. echad shel zahav mibbifnim shealav lechem happanim tamid:

Halacha: tanne. al shelkesef. ribbi yose veshem ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak. ribbi chananya matte vah mishshemeh deribbi yochanan. let kan shelkesef mippene shehu martiach. lo chen tanne. ze echad min hannissim shennaasu vevet hammikdash. shekkeshem shehayu mannichin oto chom kach hayu motziin oto chom. [shenneemar] lashum lechem chom keyom hillakcho. ribbi yehoshua ben levi amar. en mazkirin maase nissim. beon kome ribbi ila. lo haya sham lechem mahu lehannicho lashshabbat habbaa. amar lon. ketiv venatatta al hashshulechan lechem panim lefanayy tamid. lechem panim afilu fasul.

Asara shulechanot asa shelomo. vayyaas shulechanot asara vayyannach bahechol chamishsha miyyamin vachamishsha missemol. in temar. chamishsha vaddarom vachamishsha vatztzafon. vahalo en hashshulechan kasher ella vatztzafon. shenneemar veet hashshulchan titten al tzela tzafon. ma talamud lomar. chamishsha miyyamin vachamishsha missemol. ella chamishsha miyyamin shulchanu shelmoshe vachamishsha missemoolo. af al pi chen lo haya mesadder ella shelmoshe bilvad. shenneemar et hashshulechan asher alav lechem happanim. ribbi yose beribbi yehuda omer. al kullam haya mesadder. shenneemar et hashshulechanot vaalehem lechem happanim. tanne. mizrach umaarav hayu netunin. divre ribbi. ribbi elazar beribbi shimon omer. tzafon vedarom hayu netunin. man deamar. mizrach umaarav. nicha. kullehon reuyin lesherut. man deamar. tzafon vedarom. nimtza shulechan vaddarom umenora vatztzafon. veha tanne. hashshulchan haya natun mechatzi habbayit velifnim mashuch min hakkotel kishte ammot kelappe hatztzafon umenora chenegdo vedarom. mizbach hazzahav haya natun veemtza habbayit cholek et habbayit mechetzyo velifnim mashuch kima kelappe hatztzafon. vechullehom hayu netunin mishshelish habbayit velifnim.

Eser menorot asa shelomo. [shenneemar] vayyaas et menorot hazzahav eser kemishpato. yn temar. chamesh batztzafon vechamesh baddarom. vahalo en hammenora cheshera ella vaddarom. shenneemar veet hammenora nochach hashshulchan al yerach hammishkan temana. ma talamud lomar. chamesh miyyamin vechamesh missemol. ella chamesh miyyamin menorato shelmoshe vechamesh missemoolah. af al pi chen lo haya mavir ella shelmoshe bilvad. shenneemar umenorat hazzahav veneroteha levaer baerev baerev. ribbi yose beribbi yehuda omer. al kullam haya mavir. shenneemar veet hammenorot venerotehem levaaram kammishpat lifne haddevir zahav sag‍ur. vehapperach vehannerot vehammelkachayim zahav hu michlot zahav. hen kilu zehavo shelshelomo. rav yehuda veshem assi. haya shelomo notel elef kikkere zahav umachnisan (laor) [lakkur] umotzian ad shehu maamidan al echad. lekayem ma shenneemar kikkar zahav tahor asa otah vegomer. tanne. amar ribbi yose beribbi yehuda. maase vimnorat zahav sheasa moshe vammidbar vehayta yetera denar zahav. vehichnisuha lakkur shemonim paam velo chasra chelum. veyeut. ad delo yekum al berareh hava chaser saggin. min du kayaym al berareh lo chaser kelum.

Mishna: shelosha asar shofarot hayu bammikdash vechatuv alehen tiklin chadtin vetiklin attikin kinnin vegozle ola etzim levona zahav lakkapporet. shishsha lindava. tiklin chadtin shebbechol shana veshana. veattikin mi shello hevi eshtakad shokel leshana habbaa. kinnin hen torin. vegozle ola hen bene yona. kullan olot divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim kinnin echad chattat veechad ola. gozle ola kullan olot: haomer hare alay etzim lo yifchot mishshene gizyrin. levona lo yifchot mikkometz. zahav lo yifchot middinar zahav. shishsha lindava. nedava me hayu osin bah lokchin bah olot habbasar lashshem vehaorot lakkohanim. ze midrash darash yehoyada kohen gadol asham hu asom asham laAdonai. ze hakkelal kol shehu ba mishshem chet umishshem ashma yillakach bo olot habbasar lashshem vehaorot lakkohanim. nimtzeu shene ketuvin kayaymin asham layy veasham lakkohen. veomer kesef asham vechesef chattaot lo yuva bet Adonai lakkohanim yihyu:

Halacha: tanne. amar ribbi yehuda. velo haya shofar shelkinnim birushalayim mippene hattaarovet. shemma tamut achat mehen venimtzeu deme chattaot metot meuravot bahen. [veha]tanne. haishsha sheamra. hare alay kan. mevia deme kan venotnato vashshofar veochelet vakkodashim veenah chosheshet shemma nitatztzel kohen. veen hakkohen choshesh shemma deme chattaot metot meuravot bahen. [ki kaamrinan. bechattat shemmetu vaalehen vaddai. vei amrinan. nivror 4 zuze venashde binhara veiddach lishteru. ha amrinan vaalma. ribbi yehuda let leh berera.]

Ribbi yose beribbi bun amar. ribbi ba bar mamal bae. amar hare alay etz. mevi gezar echad. amar ribbi lazar. matnita amra chen. shezze karban bifne atzmo veze karban bifne atzmo. kahi detanninan tamman. shenayim beyadam shene geyzire etzim. lerabbot et haetzim.

Ribbi yehoshua ben levi amar. ovyayn (kamma chokot) [baamma shochakot]. vearkan (amma gammuda) [keamma geroma]. ribbi choni veshem ribbi immi. kemin tortani. amar ribbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak. lefi shello haya mekom hammaaracha ella amma al amma lefichach lo haya vo ella amma (gammuda) [geroma]. vetanne chen. amma hayyesod amma sovev amma karkov veamma keranot veamma maaracha.

Levona lo yifchot mikkometz. neemar kan azkara veneemar lehallan azkara. ma azkara haamura lehallan melo kometz af kan melo kometz. i ma azkara haamura lehallan shene kematzem af kan shene kematzem. amar ribbi la. kelum lamdu lekometz ella millechem happanim. ma lehallan kometz hechaser pasul af kan kometz hechaser pasul. amar ribbi yose. milleteh deribbi ila amra. hammitnaddev mincha meviah vekumetzo shelkohen gadol. ribbi chizkiyya veshem ribbi yirmeya. vaafilu bekometz habbealim.
Zahav lo yifchot middinar zahav. amar ribbi lazar. vehu shehizkir tzura. aval im lo hizkir tzura mevi afilu tzinnora.
